Applying sunscreen.start: A person flips open a sunscreen bottle, squeezes white lotion onto one palm, and rubs both hands together to spread the cream evenly.
Applying sunscreen.middle: Fingertips dab lotion onto the cheeks, nose, and forehead, then the palms rub cream over the face, arms, and shoulders in repeated strokes.
Applying sunscreen.end: The person coats the legs with long gliding passes, rubs in remaining white streaks until they disappear, then closes the bottle and inspects the glossy skin.
Applying sunscreen.global: A person applies sunscreen, squeezing lotion from a bottle and rubbing it over the face, arms, and legs until the cream is absorbed.

Archery.start: An archer stands sideways to a distant target, nocks an arrow onto the bowstring, and raises the bow arm toward the target.
Archery.middle: The archer draws the string back to anchor near the cheek, holds full draw with eyes on the target, then releases and the arrow springs forward.
Archery.end: The arrow strikes the target face and sticks quivering, and the archer lowers the bow, then reaches for another arrow to repeat the shot.
Archery.global: An archer practices archery, drawing a bow to full anchor and releasing arrows that fly across the range to stick in a round target.

Arm wrestling.start: Two opponents face each other across a table, right elbows planted, hands clasped in a firm grip while free hands grab the table edge.
Arm wrestling.middle: On the signal both arms tense with bulging muscles, trembling near the center until one competitor slowly forces the opponent's forearm to tilt down.
Arm wrestling.end: After a brief shaking stall, the winner drives the opponent's hand down against the table, and both relax, one raising a fist in victory.
Arm wrestling.global: Two people arm wrestle across a table, gripping hands with planted elbows and straining until one forces the other's arm down to the surface.

Assembling bicycle.start: A person works at a partly built bicycle frame, sliding a wheel's axle into the front fork and tightening the nuts or quick-release lever.
Assembling bicycle.middle: The seatpost and handlebars are inserted and clamped tight, a pedal is threaded onto the crank, and fingers loop the chain around the sprockets.
Assembling bicycle.end: The person spins the crank to check the chain, squeezes and adjusts the brakes, then stands the finished bicycle upright and spins the wheels.
Assembling bicycle.global: A person assembles a bicycle, attaching wheels, seatpost, handlebars, pedals, and chain with hand tools until the finished bike rolls smoothly.

BMX.start: A rider on a small BMX bike pushes off from a ramp or dirt course, pedaling hard while crouched low over the handlebars to build speed.
BMX.middle: The rider compresses at a ramp, launches both wheels into the air, tweaks the bars mid-flight, and spots the landing while leveling the bike.
BMX.end: Both tires touch down together as the rider absorbs the impact, pumps through a berm, and rolls out standing on the pedals toward the next obstacle.
BMX.global: A rider performs BMX, pedaling a small bike down ramps and dirt, launching airborne jumps with mid-air tricks and landing to carve through berms.

Baking cookies.start: In a kitchen a person creams butter and sugar in a mixing bowl, then beats in cracked eggs and vanilla until the batter turns smooth.
Baking cookies.middle: Flour is folded in to form thick dough, chocolate chips are stirred through, and rounded balls of dough are scooped and spaced on a baking sheet.
Baking cookies.end: The tray slides into the hot oven where the cookies spread and turn golden, then the person lifts warm cookies onto a cooling rack with mitts.
Baking cookies.global: A person bakes cookies, mixing butter, sugar, eggs, and flour into dough, scooping balls onto a tray, and pulling golden cookies from the oven.

Ballet.start: Dancers in leotards stand poised with rounded arms and turned-out feet, rising onto the balls of their feet and bending into deep plies.
Ballet.middle: The dancers extend legs in sweeping movements, spin through pirouettes on one leg, and run lightly across the floor into a split-legged grand jete.
Ballet.end: Landing softly into an arabesque with one leg extended behind, the dancers move together in matching formations and finish balanced in a held pose.
Ballet.global: Dancers perform ballet on a stage or studio floor, flowing through plies, pirouettes, and soaring leaps before finishing in a still, balanced pose.

Bathing dog.start: A person places a dog into a tub, wets its coat with a sprayer, and squeezes shampoo onto its back to begin rubbing.
Bathing dog.middle: Both hands massage shampoo into a lather along the dog's back, legs, belly, and head, then rinse the foam away with streams of clean water.
Bathing dog.end: The dog shakes off flying water droplets, and the person squeezes water from the fur, wraps the dog in a towel, and rubs it dry.
Bathing dog.global: A person bathes a dog in a tub, soaking its coat, lathering shampoo over its body, rinsing off the suds, and toweling it dry.

Baton twirling.start: A performer holds a slender metal baton that begins spinning in flat circles, passing from hand to hand in front of the body.
Baton twirling.middle: The baton rolls around the wrist, sweeps in wide circles beside the body, then flies spinning high overhead on a flick of the wrist.
Baton twirling.end: The performer catches the falling baton cleanly, twirls it behind the back and under a lifted leg, and ends with a high toss and raised pose.
Baton twirling.global: A performer twirls a baton, spinning it through the fingers and around the body while tossing it high overhead and catching it in flowing tricks.

Beach soccer.start: Barefoot players spread across a sand pitch with small goals, nudging the ball forward and sprinting through sprays of kicked-up sand.
Beach soccer.middle: Players flick the ball airborne off the uneven sand, control lofted passes with chest or thigh, slide for tackles, and strike acrobatic mid-air volleys.
Beach soccer.end: The goalkeeper dives across the sandy goalmouth, the ball beats the keeper into the net, and players jog back through the sand to restart.
Beach soccer.global: Players compete in beach soccer on a sand pitch, sprinting barefoot, lofting acrobatic volleys, and celebrating goals past a diving goalkeeper.

Beer pong.start: Plastic cups stand in triangles at both ends of a long table as a player aims a small white ping-pong ball at eye level.
Beer pong.middle: The ball arcs over the table and splashes into a cup, which opponents remove and drink before lofting their own toss back across.
Beer pong.end: Missed throws bounce off the table, cups disappear one by one, and when the final cup is hit the winning team celebrates with raised arms.
Beer pong.global: Players play beer pong, tossing a ping-pong ball across a long table into triangles of drink-filled cups until one team's final cup is hit.

Belly dance.start: A dancer in a fringed hip scarf stands with curved raised arms, swaying the hips side to side and snapping sharp accents that rattle the coins.
Belly dance.middle: The dancer traces figure-eight hip patterns, rolls undulations up the belly and chest, ripples the arms in serpentine waves, and vibrates a fast hip shimmy.
Belly dance.end: The dancer spins with skirt flaring, travels sideways layering shimmies over gliding steps, and ends in a held pose with one arm high and hip lifted.
Belly dance.global: A dancer performs a belly dance, isolating the hips in shimmies, figure eights, and rolling undulations while a coin scarf shimmers with each accent.

Blow-drying hair.start: A person with damp hair picks up a hair dryer before a mirror, switches it on, and sweeps warm air across the wet roots.
Blow-drying hair.middle: The free hand rakes sections apart while a round brush lifts the hair, the dryer following each section in repeated passes from roots to ends.
Blow-drying hair.end: The nozzle glides down the top layer and over the last damp patches until the hair looks glossy, then the person switches off the dryer.
Blow-drying hair.global: A person blow-dries damp hair before a mirror, sweeping a handheld dryer over lifted sections until the hair turns dry, full, and glossy.

Blowing leaves.start: A person on a leaf-covered lawn starts a leaf blower and sweeps the nozzle side to side, sending dry leaves tumbling forward in waves.
Blowing leaves.middle: Walking slowly, the person pushes a swirling front of leaves across the grass, angling the blower under bushes and herding the scattered leaves into a line.
Blowing leaves.end: The stream of leaves is steered toward a corner where a dense pile builds, then the blower shuts off and the person surveys the cleared lawn.
Blowing leaves.global: A person blows leaves with a handheld leaf blower, herding waves of tumbling dry leaves across the yard into one dense finished pile.

Braiding hair.start: A person combs long hair smooth, gathers it, divides it into three even strands, and crosses the right strand over the center one.
Braiding hair.middle: The hands weave steadily downward, alternating strand over strand in a tight regular pattern as neat ridges form down the back of the head.
Braiding hair.end: The braiding continues to the thinning ends of the hair, an elastic band is wound around the tip, and the finished braid hangs neatly down the back.
Braiding hair.global: A person braids long hair, dividing it into three strands and weaving them over each other down the back before securing the end with an elastic.

Breakdancing.start: A dancer steps into an open circle, bounces through toprock steps in rhythm, then drops down with hands on the floor into fast footwork.
Breakdancing.middle: The dancer sweeps the legs in circles on the hands, locks into balanced freezes, and whips into windmills with legs slicing wide as the torso rolls.
Breakdancing.end: Momentum carries continuous spins on the shoulders and back until the dancer pops up, hits sharp poses, and holds a final freeze before stepping out.
Breakdancing.global: A dancer breakdances inside a circle, flowing from toprock steps into floor footwork, windmills, and spins before ending in a held freeze.

Brushing hair.start: A person faces a mirror with loose hair, starting the brush at the ends and working out tangles with short strokes while holding sections.
Brushing hair.middle: The brush glides from roots to tips in long smooth strokes, repeating rhythmically through the sides and back as the free hand smooths behind it.
Brushing hair.end: Stray strands cling to the brush as the hair grows shiny, and the person gives final finishing strokes before smoothing the tidy hair with a palm.
Brushing hair.global: A person brushes their hair before a mirror, pulling a handheld brush in long repeated strokes from roots to tips until the hair is smooth and shiny.

Brushing teeth.start: A person at a bathroom sink squeezes a strip of toothpaste onto a toothbrush and begins brushing the outer surfaces of the upper teeth.
Brushing teeth.middle: The brush scrubs in small circles as white foam builds around the lips, working the lower teeth, back molars, and inner surfaces behind the front teeth.
Brushing teeth.end: After final passes over all the teeth, the person leans over the sink, spits out the foam, rinses the mouth, and rinses the brush.
Brushing teeth.global: A person brushes their teeth at a bathroom sink, scrubbing foaming toothpaste in small circles over every surface before spitting and rinsing.

Building sandcastles.start: A person kneels on the beach scooping wet sand into a plastic bucket with a shovel, patting and pressing it down to the brim.
Building sandcastles.middle: The bucket is flipped upside down, tapped, and lifted to leave molded sand towers, while hands pile connecting walls between them and pat them firm.
Building sandcastles.end: Fingers carve windows, doors, and lines into the packed walls, a moat is dug around the castle, and the finished sandcastle stands decorated with shells.
Building sandcastles.global: A person builds sandcastles on the beach, packing wet sand into buckets, molding towers and walls, and carving details before digging a moat.

Bullfighting.start: A matador in an ornate embroidered suit stands in a sand arena, planting his feet and swinging a large cape open toward a pawing bull.
Bullfighting.middle: The bull charges hard with horns lowered as the matador sweeps the cape smoothly past his body, pivoting through repeated close passes.
Bullfighting.end: After a series of thundering passes the matador finishes with a flourish, turning away as the winded bull halts, and struts to the crowd's roar.
Bullfighting.global: A matador performs bullfighting in a sand arena, swinging a cape through close passes as the charging bull thunders inches past his body.

Bungee jumping.start: A jumper stands on a high platform with an elastic cord strapped to the ankles, spreading arms wide with toes over the edge above the drop.
Bungee jumping.middle: The jumper dives off headfirst and plummets in freefall until the trailing cord stretches taut and snaps the body back upward in a sharp rebound.
Bungee jumping.end: The jumper soars up briefly weightless, the bounces shrink to a gentle upside-down sway, and the jumper is lowered back toward the recovery crew.
Bungee jumping.global: A person goes bungee jumping, diving headfirst from a high platform and plummeting until the elastic cord stretches and rebounds them through shrinking bounces.

Calf roping.start: A rider on horseback waits beside a chute, then charges after a sprinting calf while swinging a coiled lasso in fast circles overhead.
Calf roping.middle: The thrown loop settles around the calf's neck, the horse slides to a stop, and the rider dismounts, runs down the rope, and flanks the calf down.
Calf roping.end: The rider gathers three of the calf's legs, wraps them quickly with a tie rope, throws both hands up, and remounts to give the rope slack.
Calf roping.global: A rider performs calf roping, chasing a sprinting calf on horseback, lassoing its neck, then flanking it down and tying three legs together.

Camel ride.start: A kneeling camel wears a saddle as a rider swings a leg over, and the camel rises back legs first, tipping the rider sharply forward.
Camel ride.middle: The handler leads the standing camel forward, and it walks with long swaying strides while the rider rocks side to side with the rolling gait.
Camel ride.end: After plodding along the trail in a line, the camel halts, folds its front legs, and settles down so the rider can dismount from the saddle.
Camel ride.global: A person takes a camel ride, mounting a kneeling camel that rises and plods along with a rolling gait before kneeling again for the dismount.

Canoeing.start: Two paddlers climb into a canoe at the bow and stern, push away from shore, and plant their single-bladed paddles to pull along the hull.
Canoeing.middle: Both paddlers stroke in rhythm on opposite sides, water dripping from raised blades, the stern paddler steering while they switch sides in unison.
Canoeing.end: The paddlers ease their pace and let the canoe drift with blades resting across the gunwales, then nose back to shore and drag it onto the bank.
Canoeing.global: Two people go canoeing, paddling in rhythm on opposite sides of a gliding canoe before drifting back and dragging it onto the shore.

Capoeira.start: Two players cartwheel into the middle of a circle of people and sway in the ginga, one swinging a slow high crescent kick toward the partner.
Capoeira.middle: The partner ducks low under the kick and answers with spinning kicks of their own, both flowing through cartwheels and dodges in constant motion.
Capoeira.end: The players circle with feints, sweeps, and brief handstand balances, then wind down the exchange and shake hands or cartwheel out as others enter.
Capoeira.global: Two players perform capoeira inside a circle, swaying in the ginga and exchanging spinning kicks, ducking escapes, and cartwheels without quite touching.

Carving jack-o-lanterns.start: A person saws a circular lid around a pumpkin's stem with a knife, lifts it off by the stem, and reveals the stringy pulp inside.
Carving jack-o-lanterns.middle: Hands scoop out clumps of seeds and pulp, scrape the inner walls clean, draw a face on the shell, and saw carefully along an eye outline.
Carving jack-o-lanterns.end: Cut pieces are pushed out to open triangular eyes, a nose, and a jagged mouth, then a candle goes inside and the jack-o-lantern glows.
Carving jack-o-lanterns.global: A person carves a jack-o-lantern, cutting a lid from a pumpkin, scooping out the seeds and pulp, and sawing a glowing face into the shell.

Changing car wheel.start: Beside a car with a flat tire, a person fetches the jack and spare, pries off the hubcap, and heaves the wrench to crack each lug nut loose.
Changing car wheel.middle: The jack cranks the car's body up until the flat lifts clear, the loosened nuts spin off, and the heavy spare is aligned onto the hub bolts.
Changing car wheel.end: The person threads the lug nuts on in a star pattern, lowers the car back onto the pavement, tightens each nut firmly, and packs away the tools.
Changing car wheel.global: A person changes a car wheel, jacking up the vehicle, removing the flat tire, and bolting on the spare before lowering the car and tightening the nuts.

Cheerleading.start: A uniformed squad runs onto the floor, snaps into formation, and punches sharp synchronized arm motions with flashing pom-poms while chanting and clapping in rhythm.
Cheerleading.middle: Cheerleaders spring into toe-touch jumps, then bases dip and press a flyer high overhead, holding steady as the flyer pulls a heel stretch.
Cheerleading.end: The bases toss the flyer into a twisting cradle catch, tumblers whip through cartwheels and flips, and the routine ends in a posed pyramid.
Cheerleading.global: A squad performs cheerleading, chanting through synchronized arm motions and jumps, lifting and tossing flyers overhead, and finishing posed in a pyramid.

Chopping wood.start: A person stands a round log upright on a chopping block, grips an axe with feet planted wide, and swings the blade high overhead.
Chopping wood.middle: The axe drives down hard, biting into the log with a crack that bursts it apart, and the person sets a half back up on the block.
Chopping wood.end: Swing after swing splits the halves into narrower firewood, split pieces scattering around the block until the person gathers and stacks them in a neat pile.
Chopping wood.global: A person chops wood, swinging an axe overhead onto upright logs on a block, splitting them into firewood and stacking the pieces neatly.

Clean and jerk.start: A lifter grips a loaded barbell with flat back and crouched hips, then pulls it up along the shins as the legs drive and the back extends.
Clean and jerk.middle: The lifter extends explosively, drops under the bar to catch it on the shoulders, sinks into a full front squat, and stands up with the weight.
Clean and jerk.end: The lifter dips and drives the bar overhead into a split, holds it steady on locked arms, then drops the barbell crashing onto the platform.
Clean and jerk.global: A lifter performs a clean and jerk, pulling a heavy barbell up to the shoulders, squatting up, and driving it overhead on locked arms.

Cleaning shoes.start: A person sits with a shoe in hand, brushing loose dirt off the sole and upper, then wiping the surface clean with a damp cloth.
Cleaning shoes.middle: Polish is worked into the leather in small circles, allowed to sit, then brushed briskly back and forth as the leather starts to shine.
Cleaning shoes.end: A soft cloth buffs the toe cap to a deep gloss, the second shoe gets matching treatment, and both gleaming shoes are set side by side.
Cleaning shoes.global: A person cleans shoes, brushing away dirt, rubbing polish into the leather with small circles, and buffing both shoes until they gleam.

Cleaning sink.start: A person clears items from the sink basin, rinses away loose debris, and sprays cleaner across the surface until it is coated in foam.
Cleaning sink.middle: The sponge scrubs the basin in circles, pressing on grime around the drain, then wipes the faucet bases while a toothbrush digs into the seams.
Cleaning sink.end: The tap rinses foam and loosened grime down the drain, the faucet and rim are wiped free of water spots, and the gleaming sink is dried.
Cleaning sink.global: A person cleans a sink, spraying cleaner into the basin, scrubbing grime with a sponge, and rinsing everything down the drain until it gleams.

Cleaning windows.start: A person sprays a mist of cleaner across a glass window and starts wiping from the top corner with a cloth or squeegee.
Cleaning windows.middle: Wide overlapping strokes and straight squeegee pulls clear strips of foam down the pane, with stubborn spots getting a second spray and a firm rub.
Cleaning windows.end: The person reaches the upper corners from a stool, wipes the edges and sill dry, and steps back to check the streak-free glass in the light.
Cleaning windows.global: A person cleans windows, spraying cleaner onto the glass and pulling a squeegee or cloth in overlapping strokes until the pane is streak-free.

Clipping cat claws.start: A person sits with a cat on their lap, strokes it calm, lifts a front paw, and presses the pad so the curved claws extend.
Clipping cat claws.middle: The clipper snips off each translucent claw tip with a small click, avoiding the pink quick, while the person pauses to soothe the shifting cat.
Clipping cat claws.end: The second paw is trimmed claw by claw, each tip checked and re-clipped if still long, and the cat hops away as the clippers are put away.
Clipping cat claws.global: A person clips a cat's claws, pressing each toe to extend the claw and snipping the sharp tips one at a time while soothing the cat.

Cricket.start: Players spread across a grass oval as the bowler sprints in and whirls the arm over, releasing the ball toward the batsman at the wicket.
Cricket.middle: The batsman swings the flat bat with a crack, sending the bouncing ball across the field, while fielders chase it and the batsmen sprint between wickets.
Cricket.end: Deliveries continue as lofted shots hang in the air for fielders or clear the rope, and players swap ends between overs on the wide oval.
Cricket.global: Players compete in cricket on a grass oval, a bowler delivering the ball to a batsman who strikes it while fielders chase and batsmen run.

Croquet.start: Players with long-handled mallets stand on a lawn dotted with wire hoops, one lining up behind a colored ball and swinging the mallet gently back.
Croquet.middle: The mallet taps the ball rolling across the short grass, strokes it through narrow hoops, and knocks an opponent's ball away across the lawn.
Croquet.end: Players take turns around the course as balls click and scatter, until the final ball is tapped against the center peg to finish the game.
Croquet.global: Players play croquet on a flat lawn, tapping colored balls with long-handled mallets through narrow wire hoops toward the center peg.

Cumbia.start: Couples face each other on a dance floor, stepping in a gentle back-and-forth rhythm while a woman sweeps her wide skirt in waves.
Cumbia.middle: Her partner circles her with short shuffling steps, one hand behind his back, as the couple orbit each other with rolling hips and swirling skirt.
Cumbia.end: The partners advance and retreat playfully with other couples circling in loose formation, finishing the song with a final turn and a flourish of the skirt.
Cumbia.global: Couples dance cumbia, orbiting each other with short shuffling steps and swaying hips while the women sweep their wide skirts in flowing arcs.

Curling.start: A curler crouches in the hack gripping a polished stone, pushes off, and slides low across the ice in a long one-footed lunge.
Curling.middle: The hand releases the stone with a gentle turn, and two teammates with brooms scrub the ice furiously ahead of it on the skip's shout.
Curling.end: The sweepers ease off as the stone glides into the house, tapping an opponent's stone or settling near the button while players study the rings.
Curling.global: Players compete in curling on an ice sheet, sliding a rotating stone toward the circular house while sweepers scrub the ice ahead of it.

Cutting the grass.start: A person wheels a lawn mower onto an overgrown lawn, starts it with a pull of the cord, and pushes it forward into the tall grass.
Cutting the grass.middle: The mower cuts clean strips with clippings spraying into the bag, swinging around at each edge to travel back and forth in overlapping rows.
Cutting the grass.end: The person steers around trees and corners, empties the clipping bag, finishes the last rows, and shuts off the mower to survey the even lawn.
Cutting the grass.global: A person cuts the grass with a lawn mower, pushing it back and forth in overlapping rows until the overgrown lawn is evenly trimmed.

Decorating the Christmas tree.start: People open boxes of ornaments beside a bare green tree, untangle a string of glowing lights, and wind them around the branches in spirals.
Decorating the Christmas tree.middle: Garland is draped in even loops while family members hang shiny baubles one by one, a child reaching for higher branches guided by an adult.
Decorating the Christmas tree.end: Someone climbs a stool to set the star on top, the lights switch on, and everyone tidies the empty boxes while admiring the glowing tree.
Decorating the Christmas tree.global: A family decorates the Christmas tree, winding lights in spirals, hanging baubles and garland, and topping it with a star before the lights sparkle.

Disc dog.start: A handler with a stack of flying discs whips one away in a flat sailing throw, and the crouched dog explodes into a sprint after it.
Disc dog.middle: The dog leaps with body stretched to snatch the disc in its mouth, races back, and tracks the next curving throws before springing up again.
Disc dog.end: The dog bounces off the handler's body for high trick catches, snagging disc after disc mid-air, then trots back tail wagging to the applauding handler.
Disc dog.global: A handler and dog perform disc dog on an open field, the dog sprinting and leaping to snatch thrown flying discs out of the air.

Discus throw.start: A thrower steps into the concrete circle holding the flat discus, swinging it in long preliminary arm sweeps before coiling with weight on the back leg.
Discus throw.middle: The thrower pivots and spins across the circle with the discus trailing at arm's length, hips firing through as the arm slings it in a flat arc.
Discus throw.end: The discus rips off the index finger and sails spinning in a long shallow arc, landing far out in the grass as the thrower reverses the feet.
Discus throw.global: An athlete performs a discus throw, spinning across the concrete circle and slinging the flat discus in a wide arc far out over the field.

Dodgeball.start: Two teams line up on opposite sides of a gym court, sprint to the center line at the starting signal, and grab the rubber balls.
Dodgeball.middle: Players hurl balls hard across the court while targets dive and twist out of the way, hits sending players off and clean catches eliminating throwers.
Dodgeball.end: The teams thin out as remaining players duck through the crossfire, until the last opponent is hit and the winners throw up their arms cheering.
Dodgeball.global: Two teams play dodgeball in a gym, hurling rubber balls across the court while opponents dodge, catch, and get eliminated one by one.

Doing a powerbomb.start: Two wrestlers circle in a ring until one doubles the opponent over, tucks the head between his thighs, and locks both arms around the waist.
Doing a powerbomb.middle: The attacker hoists the opponent upside down, flips him up to sit on his shoulders high above the mat, and steadies himself under the weight.
Doing a powerbomb.end: The attacker drives forward and slams the opponent's back flat onto the canvas with a booming impact, then rises as the winded wrestler lies flat.
Doing a powerbomb.global: A wrestler performs a powerbomb, lifting the opponent up onto his shoulders and slamming him back-first onto the mat with a ring-shaking impact.

Doing crunches.start: A person lies on their back on a mat with knees bent, hands beside the head, and curls the head and shoulders up off the floor.
Doing crunches.middle: The upper back lifts a few inches with elbows drifting toward the knees, holds briefly with tensed abdominals, then lowers with control and curls up again.
Doing crunches.end: Repetitions continue in a small rhythmic arc with an exhale on each lift, until the final crunch ends with the person lying flat, arms dropped.
Doing crunches.global: A person does crunches on a mat, repeatedly curling the head and shoulders off the floor with bent knees and tensed abdominal muscles.

Doing fencing.start: Two fencers in white jackets and mesh masks salute on a narrow strip, snap into en garde, and bounce through small advancing and retreating steps.
Doing fencing.middle: One fencer lunges with the blade shooting toward the chest, the defender parries with a metallic ring and ripostes, blades bending through rapid exchanges.
Doing fencing.end: A tip lands on the jacket and the scoring light flashes, the fencers reset en garde, and after the final touch they unmask and shake hands.
Doing fencing.global: Two fencers duel on a narrow strip, lunging and parrying with flexible blades until scoring lights flash and they unmask to shake hands.

Doing karate.start: A karateka in a white gi bows on the mat, drops into a wide low stance, and snaps sharp straight punches out from the hip.
Doing karate.middle: Stepping across the mat with loud shouts, the karateka sweeps crisp blocks across the body and fires snapping front kicks and whipping roundhouse kicks.
Doing karate.end: The kata flows faster with punches, blocks, and kicks chained to sharp exhalations, until the karateka draws the feet together and bows once more.
Doing karate.global: A karateka practices karate solo on a mat, moving through kata stances with chambered punches, crisp blocks, and snapping kicks between bows.

Doing kickboxing.start: Two gloved fighters square up with raised guards, circling lightly on the balls of their feet and snapping quick jabs that get slipped or blocked.
Doing kickboxing.middle: Low roundhouse kicks thud into thighs and pads, punch combinations smack against gloves, and one fighter lifts a knee to check an incoming kick.
Doing kickboxing.end: The fighters trade flurries of punches flowing into kicks, circle apart breathing hard, and touch gloves at the round's end before pacing to their corners.
Doing kickboxing.global: Two fighters practice kickboxing, circling with raised gloves and trading jabs, punch combinations, and thudding roundhouse kicks until the round ends.

Doing motocross.start: A rider in helmet and armor launches a dirt bike down a rough track, standing on the pegs as the rear tire spits dirt over bumps.
Doing motocross.middle: The bike leans hard through rutted berms, charges a tabletop jump, and flies airborne while the rider levels or whips it before the down-slope landing.
Doing motocross.end: The suspension squashes on landing, the bike skips rhythmically across a set of whoops, and blasts past the finish line with dirt spraying behind.
Doing motocross.global: A rider does motocross on a dirt course, hammering over bumps and berms and soaring off jumps before landing and racing to the finish.

Doing nails.start: A person sits at a table with files and polish, clipping each fingernail to an even length and filing the tips smooth into shape.
Doing nails.middle: Cuticles are pushed back with a small tool, the polish bottle is shaken open, and the brush paints careful stripes of color down each nail.
Doing nails.end: The person blows on the wet nails to dry the first coat, brushes on a glossy topcoat, and spreads the fingers to admire the finish.
Doing nails.global: A person does their nails, clipping and filing each fingernail before painting on coats of polish and drying them to a glossy finish.

Doing step aerobics.start: A group of people faces the instructor behind low step platforms in a fitness studio and steps up onto them in unison as music sets the beat.
Doing step aerobics.middle: Participants step down and up in repeating cycles, alternating the leading foot while raising their arms, then quicken the tempo with small knee lifts.
Doing step aerobics.end: The group taps and turns to the side, gradually slows to marching in place, then stands beside the platforms stretching and breathing heavily.
Doing step aerobics.global: A group of people doing step aerobics steps rhythmically up and down on low platforms in a fitness studio, following an instructor to music.

Drinking beer.start: A person at a table tilts a bottle and pours golden beer into a glass until white foam settles on top of the amber liquid.
Drinking beer.middle: The person lifts the full glass to the lips for a long first sip, then friends clink their glasses together over the table before drinking again.
Drinking beer.end: The person takes another sip, sets the glass down and wipes their mouth while chatting, leaving a nearly empty glass with traces of foam.
Drinking beer.global: A person drinking beer at a home table pours from a bottle into a glass and sips repeatedly while socializing with friends.

Drinking coffee.start: A person sits at a table with a steaming cup, wraps a hand around the mug's handle, and slowly lifts it toward the mouth.
Drinking coffee.middle: The person blows across the hot surface, takes a small careful first sip, then drinks again while cradling the warm mug in both hands.
Drinking coffee.end: The person stirs the coffee with a small spoon, drinks more deeply as it cools, then sets the nearly empty cup on its saucer and leans back.
Drinking coffee.global: A person drinking coffee at a table lifts a steaming mug repeatedly, sipping slowly and savoring the warm drink until the cup is nearly empty.

Drum corps.start: A uniformed drum line stands in formation with drums strapped to harnesses, raises sticks in unison, and the snares strike the first tightly synchronized notes.
Drum corps.middle: Bass drums add deep pulsing beats and cymbals crash as the corps marches forward in step, ranks wheeling and crossing while keeping steady cadence.
Drum corps.end: Snare players blur through a rapid unison roll, the full percussion section pounds out the climax, and a final accented hit halts the marchers in formation.
Drum corps.global: A uniformed drum corps marches outdoors in formation, snare, tenor, and bass drummers pounding synchronized rhythms with cymbal crashes until a final accented hit.

Elliptical trainer.start: A person steps onto the pedals of an elliptical machine, presses buttons on the console, and the feet begin gliding in slow ovals.
Elliptical trainer.middle: Arms push and pull the long handles in rhythm with striding legs as the pace quickens and the person leans forward, breathing hard.
Elliptical trainer.end: Sweating and glancing at the console readout, the person gradually slows the motion until the pedals stop and steps off, reaching for a towel.
Elliptical trainer.global: A person works out on an elliptical trainer in a gym, legs and arms cycling smoothly together through a steady, sweeping whole-body stride.

Fixing bicycle.start: Beside an upside-down bicycle, a person spins the wheel to inspect it and loosens the wheel nuts with a wrench in short strokes.
Fixing bicycle.middle: The person removes the wheel, levers the tire off the rim, patches the punctured inner tube, and presses the tire bead back into place.
Fixing bicycle.end: The wheel is refitted and tightened with the wrench, the person spins it and squeezes the brakes, then turns the bike upright and rolls it forward.
Fixing bicycle.global: A person fixing a bicycle works with hand tools on an upturned bike, removing the wheel, patching the tube, and reassembling everything to test the repair.

Fixing the roof.start: A person climbs a ladder with tools, steps carefully onto the sloped roof, and lifts a cracked shingle to inspect the damage underneath.
Fixing the roof.middle: The person pries the old shingle loose with a flat bar, slides a new one into line, and hammers it down with repeated steady blows.
Fixing the roof.end: The person squeezes sealant along the seams in an even line, presses the patch down to check it, then climbs back down the ladder with the tools.
Fixing the roof.global: A person fixing the roof crouches on the sloped shingles, replacing a damaged shingle with hammer, flat bar, and sealant before descending the ladder.

Fun sliding down.start: A person climbs the steps of a tall slide holding the rails, sits at the top gripping the sides, and pushes off down the smooth chute.
Fun sliding down.middle: The person speeds down the steepening slope, hair and clothes streaming back, leaning back with legs stretched forward and arms lifted slightly for balance.
Fun sliding down.end: The slide levels out and the person slows, feet reaching the ground off the chute's end, then stands laughing and walks away glancing back.
Fun sliding down.global: A person having fun sliding down climbs a tall outdoor slide and glides quickly down its smooth chute to land laughing at the bottom.

Futsal.start: Two teams spread across a hard indoor court, a player taps the small ball from the center, and quick short passes move it across the floor.
Futsal.middle: A player dribbles forward shielding the ball with close footwork, drags it past a lunging defender, exchanges a fast one-two, and strikes hard at the small goal.
Futsal.end: The goalkeeper dives with arms stretched, the ball hits the net, the scorer celebrates with raised arms, and players jog back for the restart.
Futsal.global: Two teams play futsal on a hard indoor court, passing and dribbling a small low-bounce ball with quick footwork toward small indoor goals.

Gargling mouthwash.start: A person at a bathroom sink pours brightly colored mouthwash into a small cup, raises it to the lips, and takes the liquid into the mouth.
Gargling mouthwash.middle: With cheeks puffed, the person swishes the liquid side to side, then tilts the head back and gargles for several seconds in a steady bubbling rhythm.
Gargling mouthwash.end: The person leans over the sink and spits out the mouthwash, watches it swirl down the drain, then recaps the bottle and returns it to the shelf.
Gargling mouthwash.global: A person gargling mouthwash at a bathroom sink swishes and gargles the colored liquid with head tilted back before spitting it out.

Getting a haircut.start: A hairdresser drapes a cape around a seated client, sprays and combs the hair evenly, then lifts a section between two fingers with scissors ready.
Getting a haircut.middle: The scissors snip raised strands as clippings fall onto the cape, electric clippers buzz along the sides, and the hairdresser compares lengths beside the ears.
Getting a haircut.end: Loose hairs are brushed from the client's neck, a mirror is held behind the head to show the finished cut, and the cape is removed as the client stands.
Getting a haircut.global: A client getting a haircut sits caped in a chair while a hairdresser combs, snips with scissors, and shapes the hairline with buzzing clippers.

Getting a piercing.start: A gloved piercer arranges sterile tools beside a seated client, cleans the skin with an antiseptic wipe, and marks a small dot at the chosen spot.
Getting a piercing.middle: The client holds still as the piercer aligns the needle with the mark, steadies the area with one hand, and pushes it through in one quick controlled motion.
Getting a piercing.end: The piercer slides the jewelry into the fresh hole, fastens the backing, dabs the area with gauze, and the client checks the piercing in a hand mirror.
Getting a piercing.global: A client getting a piercing sits still while a gloved piercer marks the skin, pushes a needle through, and fastens new jewelry in place.

Getting a tattoo.start: A tattoo artist shaves and cleans the client's resting arm, presses a stencil onto the skin, and peels the paper away leaving purple design outlines.
Getting a tattoo.middle: The artist dips the buzzing machine's needle into black ink and traces steadily along the stencil lines, pausing to wipe excess ink with a paper towel.
Getting a tattoo.end: The artist shades with small overlapping circular strokes, fills the design with color while wiping between passes, then cleans the finished tattoo and covers it with protective wrap.
Getting a tattoo.global: A client getting a tattoo rests an arm on a padded support while the artist traces and shades the inked design with a buzzing needle machine.

Grooming dog.start: A dog stands on a grooming table while a person gathers brushes and clippers, calms it with gentle strokes, and begins brushing the coat in long passes.
Grooming dog.middle: Loose fur collects in the brush as the person combs out tangles, guides electric clippers along the dog's back and sides, and trims each paw's nails.
Grooming dog.end: The person snips carefully around the face and ears, brushes the coat smooth a final time, and lifts the cleanly groomed dog down from the table.
Grooming dog.global: A person grooming a dog on a table brushes out loose fur, trims the coat with clippers, and clips nails until the coat looks clean and even.

Grooming horse.start: A person sets down a box of brushes beside a tied horse, pats its neck softly, and works a curry comb in circular strokes over the coat.
Grooming horse.middle: Dust rises as the person sweeps a stiff brush in short flicks along the coat, combs the mane apart, and picks debris from a lifted hoof.
Grooming horse.end: The person cleans each remaining hoof in turn, passes a soft brush lightly over the face and ears, and smooths the coat until the horse stands glossy.
Grooming horse.global: A person grooming a horse outdoors brushes its coat with combs and brushes, untangles the mane, and picks each hoof clean.

Hammer throw.start: An athlete grips the hammer's handle with both hands inside the throwing circle and swings it in wide circles overhead to build momentum.
Hammer throw.middle: The athlete turns on the balls of the feet through several rapid rotations, leaning back against the heavy ball's pull, then drives up hard on the final turn.
Hammer throw.end: The athlete releases the handle and the hammer arcs high over the field, wire trailing, before landing in the grass sector with a heavy thud.
Hammer throw.global: An athlete performs a hammer throw, whirling the heavy ball on its wire through fast spins in the circle before launching it far across the field.

Hand car wash.start: A person hoses loose dirt from a parked car, then dips a large sponge into a bucket of soapy water, soaking it with thick suds.
Hand car wash.middle: The soapy sponge moves in circular strokes over the hood, roof, doors, and side panels, and the person crouches to scrub the grimy wheels and lower panels.
Hand car wash.end: The person rinses the foam off in sheets with the hose, wipes the car dry panel by panel with a large cloth, and admires the gleaming finish.
Hand car wash.global: A person gives a car a hand wash outdoors, scrubbing the paintwork with a soapy sponge, rinsing with a hose, and drying it with a cloth.

Hand washing clothes.start: A person crouches beside a basin, submerges a garment until it soaks through, and rubs soap onto the wet fabric, working up a thick white lather.
Hand washing clothes.middle: The person scrubs the cloth against itself with both fists in a steady rhythm, dunks it repeatedly through the soapy water, then replaces the water for rinsing.
Hand washing clothes.end: The person rinses the garment until the water runs clear, twists it tightly to wring out the water, then shakes it out and hangs it to dry.
Hand washing clothes.global: A person hand washing clothes crouches over a basin, scrubbing soapy garments with both hands, rinsing them clean, and wringing them out to dry.

Hanging wallpaper.start: A person measures and cuts a wallpaper strip on a long table, then spreads paste evenly over its back with a wide brush.
Hanging wallpaper.middle: The person carries the folded pasted strip to the wall, aligns its top with the ceiling line, smooths it downward, and works air bubbles out to the edges.
Hanging wallpaper.end: The person trims excess paper at the baseboard, hangs the next strip matching the pattern at the seam, and wipes the seams with a damp sponge.
Hanging wallpaper.global: A person hanging wallpaper pastes cut strips, presses them onto the wall in vertical alignment, and smooths and trims them for a seamless papered finish.

Having an ice cream.start: A person walks outdoors holding a cone topped with a scoop, raises it to the mouth, and licks around the base where the ice cream meets the cone.
Having an ice cream.middle: The person catches drips with quick licks, rotates the cone to keep the melting edges even, and the scoop slowly shrinks with each small lick.
Having an ice cream.end: The person bites into the crisp wafer rim with a crunch, eats down the shrinking cone bite by bite, then pops in the last piece and licks their fingers.
Having an ice cream.global: A person having an ice cream strolls outdoors, licking the melting scoop and rotating the cone before crunching through the wafer itself.

High jump.start: An athlete faces the distant crossbar and landing mat, then runs along a curving approach path, leaning into the final accelerating strides.
High jump.middle: The athlete plants the outside foot, launches off one leg, turns in the air, and arches backward over the bar as the hips clear it.
High jump.end: The athlete flicks the heels clear of the bar, drops back-first with arms spread, and lands on the thick mat before rolling up to sit.
High jump.global: An athlete performing a high jump sprints along a curved approach and arches backward over the crossbar before landing on the padded mat.

Hitting a pinata.start: Children gather under a colorful pinata hanging from a rope while an adult blindfolds one child, hands over a long stick, and spins and guides them toward it.
Hitting a pinata.middle: The blindfolded child swings the stick as onlookers shout directions, first missing the swaying pinata, then clipping it spinning, and finally landing a hit that cracks it.
Hitting a pinata.end: A hard swing splits the pinata open and candy spills out, children rush to scoop the scattered sweets while the broken shell swings empty on its rope.
Hitting a pinata.global: A blindfolded child hitting a pinata swings a stick at the colorful hanging figure until it breaks open and candy showers the excited children below.

Hopscotch.start: A child at the base of a chalk-drawn numbered grid tosses a small stone onto the first square and hops one-footed into the next, skipping the stone's square.
Hopscotch.middle: The child hops square to square on one foot, lands with both feet on the side-by-side squares, turns at the grid's end, and hops back toward the stone.
Hopscotch.end: Balancing on one foot, the child bends to pick up the stone, hops over its square back to the start, and jumps out to begin the next round.
Hopscotch.global: A child plays hopscotch on a chalk grid drawn on pavement, tossing a stone and hopping between numbered squares on one and two feet.

Horseback riding.start: A person adjusts the stirrup beside a saddled horse, swings a leg over into the saddle, and nudges the horse forward into a slow walk.
Horseback riding.middle: The rider sits upright as the horse walks, presses with the heels into a bouncing trot, rising and sitting in rhythm until the horse picks up a smooth canter.
Horseback riding.end: Leaning slightly forward, the rider guides the horse along a curve, draws back the reins to slow it to a walk, and pats its neck after halting.
Horseback riding.global: A rider goes horseback riding across an open field, mounting the saddled horse and moving through walk, trot, and canter before halting to dismount.

Hula hoop.start: A person steps inside a large hoop, lifts it to waist level against the lower back, and flings it into a spin with a sharp hip twist.
Hula hoop.middle: The hoop circles the waist as the hips rock rhythmically, knees soft and arms lifted clear, and the person raises both arms overhead while it whirls smoothly.
Hula hoop.end: The hoop dips and the person speeds the hip motion to lift it level, then lets it slow, sink around the hips, and drop to the floor.
Hula hoop.global: A person spins a hula hoop around the waist with rhythmic hip motion, keeping the whirling hoop level until letting it fall and stepping out.

Hurling.start: Helmeted players carrying flat wooden hurleys spread across a grass pitch, clash for the thrown-in ball, and one catches it one-handed while holding the hurley.
Hurling.middle: The player runs balancing the ball on the hurley's flat face, tosses it up as an opponent closes in, and strikes it soaring far downfield.
Hurling.end: A teammate leaps to catch the dropping ball one-handed, swings the hurley fully toward the H-shaped posts, and the ball flies over the crossbar for a point.
Hurling.global: Helmeted teams play hurling on a grass pitch, catching and striking a small ball with flat wooden hurleys toward tall H-shaped goalposts.

Ice fishing.start: A person in heavy winter clothing walks across a frozen lake with gear, positions an auger, and turns it steadily to cut a round hole through the ice.
Ice fishing.middle: The person scoops slush from the hole with a skimmer, baits and lowers a line, then sits on a bucket jigging the rod with small upward twitches.
Ice fishing.end: The rod tip dips suddenly, the person lifts sharply to set the hook, reels in steadily, and pulls a flapping fish up through the icy hole.
Ice fishing.global: A person goes ice fishing on a frozen lake, drilling a hole with an auger and jigging a baited line until a fish is pulled up.

Installing carpet.start: A person carries a large carpet roll into an empty room, unrolls it toward the far wall, and spreads it flat with edges lapping against the walls.
Installing carpet.middle: Kneeling, the person strikes a knee kicker to stretch the carpet toward the wall, presses the edge onto the tack strip, and trims the excess with a utility knife.
Installing carpet.end: Working along each wall kicking, stretching, and trimming, the person tucks the edges under the baseboard, smooths the finished carpet, and collects the scraps and tools.
Installing carpet.global: A person installing carpet unrolls it across a bare room, stretches it wall to wall with a knee kicker, and trims and tucks the edges neatly.

Ironing clothes.start: A person spreads a wrinkled shirt on an ironing board, heats the plugged-in iron, and sprays a light mist of water over the creased fabric.
Ironing clothes.middle: The hot iron glides slowly across the fabric flattening wrinkles, runs along a sleeve in steady steaming strokes, and presses the collar and cuffs with its pointed tip.
Ironing clothes.end: The person irons the remaining panels smooth, stands the iron upright and holds the shirt up to check for creases, then folds it or slips it onto a hanger.
Ironing clothes.global: A person ironing clothes glides a hot steaming iron over a garment on an ironing board, pressing every panel until the fabric lies smooth.

Javelin throw.start: An athlete holds the javelin level beside the head at the runway's end, then runs and accelerates with the javelin steady above the shoulder.
Javelin throw.middle: The athlete draws the throwing arm straight back, performs fast crossover steps with hips turned sideways, plants the front leg, and snaps the arm forward to release.
Javelin throw.end: The javelin climbs in a long arc over the field while the athlete brakes behind the foul line, then it sticks point-first into the distant grass.
Javelin throw.global: An athlete performs a javelin throw, sprinting down the runway with the spear overhead and hurling it in a long arc across the field.

Kayaking.start: A person seated in a kayak grips a double-bladed paddle, pushes off from the shore, and dips the first blade to pull alongside the hull.
Kayaking.middle: The kayak glides forward as the paddle swings side to side in alternating strokes, water dripping from the raised blade, and a wide sweep turns the bow.
Kayaking.end: The person slows the paddling and drifts with the paddle resting across the deck, then paddles toward shore and lets the kayak slide onto the bank.
Kayaking.global: A person goes kayaking on open water, propelling the slim boat forward with rhythmic alternating strokes of a double-bladed paddle.

Kite flying.start: A person unpacks a colorful kite in an open field, holds it up to feel the wind, and releases it into a gust as line slips from the spool.
Kite flying.middle: The kite climbs with tail fluttering as the person tugs the line in short pulls, then steadies high in the sky and swoops as the line is steered sideways.
Kite flying.end: When the kite dips in a lull, the person reels in quickly, then winds the spool steadily until the kite settles onto the grass and the line is gathered.
Kite flying.global: A person flying a kite in an open field pays out and tugs a long line, steering the colorful kite as it soars and swoops overhead.

Kneeling.start: A person stands upright on a mat with arms relaxed, bends both knees, and lowers the body until one knee touches down on the mat.
Kneeling.middle: The second knee lowers into a full kneel, the hips settle back toward the heels, and the person holds the position steadily with hands resting on the thighs.
Kneeling.end: The person shifts weight forward off the heels, lifts one knee to plant that foot flat, and pushes through it to rise back to standing.
Kneeling.global: A person demonstrates kneeling on a mat, lowering from standing onto both knees, holding the upright kneeling pose, and rising back to their feet.

Knitting.start: A person sits holding two knitting needles beside a ball of yarn, loops the working yarn over a finger, and slips the right needle into the first stitch.
Knitting.middle: The person wraps yarn around the needle tip, draws each new loop through, slides old stitches off in steady rhythm, and swaps needles at the row's end.
Knitting.end: The knitted fabric grows longer below the needles as rows accumulate, the person pulls more yarn free, then spreads the piece flat to admire the even stitches.
Knitting.global: A seated person knitting with two needles works yarn stitch by stitch in a steady rhythm as the fabric slowly lengthens.

Laying tile.start: A person kneels beside stacked tiles, scoops mortar with a notched trowel, spreads it over the floor, and combs it into even parallel ridges.
Laying tile.middle: The person presses the first tile into the mortar with a seating twist, checks its alignment, places corner spacers, and sets the next tile snug against them.
Laying tile.end: The person taps the tiles level with a rubber mallet, confirms flatness with a spirit level, wipes stray mortar away, and continues row by row across the floor.
Laying tile.global: A person laying tile kneels on a bare floor, spreading ridged mortar and pressing tiles into place with spacers to build a flat even surface.

Layup drill in basketball.start: Players form two lines near half court, and the first player dribbles toward the basket at an angle, gathering the ball with a long step inside the key.
Layup drill in basketball.middle: The player jumps off the inside foot and banks the ball softly off the backboard square, it drops through the net, and a rebounder collects it.
Layup drill in basketball.end: The rebounder passes out to the next waiting shooter, both players jog to the back of opposite lines, and the drill repeats in a continuous cycle.
Layup drill in basketball.global: Players run a layup drill in basketball, taking turns dribbling from two lines to bank soft layups off the backboard while others rebound and pass.

Long jump.start: An athlete focused on the distant sand pit sprints down the runway, arms driving, reaching near full speed with long rhythmic strides as the board approaches.
Long jump.middle: The athlete hits the takeoff board with one foot, launches into the air driving the free knee up, and cycles the legs while extending both far forward.
Long jump.end: Reaching the arms past the outstretched legs, the athlete strikes the sand heels-first, folds forward over the landing, and stands to look back at the mark.
Long jump.global: An athlete performs a long jump, sprinting down the runway and leaping from the takeoff board to land far ahead in the sand pit.

Longboarding.start: A person sets a longboard on smooth pavement, pushes off the ground with the back foot several times, and places both feet on the rolling deck.
Longboarding.middle: Crouching with knees bent, the person carves smooth S-curves by shifting weight between heels and toes, gaining speed down a gentle slope as wind ripples their clothes.
Longboarding.end: Spreading the arms for balance, the person drags the back foot lightly to shed speed until the board stops, then steps off and picks it up.
Longboarding.global: A person longboarding on smooth urban pavement pushes off, cruises with bent knees, and carves long flowing curves before braking to a stop.

Making a cake.start: A person lays out flour, eggs, sugar, and butter on the counter, cracks the eggs into a bowl, and whisks the mixture until pale and creamy.
Making a cake.middle: The person folds sifted flour in gently with a spatula, pours the smooth batter into a greased round pan, and slides it into the oven where it rises golden.
Making a cake.end: The person removes the baked cake to cool on a rack, spreads frosting over its top and sides, then decorates it and cuts a neat slice.
Making a cake.global: A person making a cake in a home kitchen mixes batter from eggs, sugar, butter, and flour, bakes it golden, and frosts and decorates it.

Making a lemonade.start: A person gathers lemons, sugar, a pitcher, and a juicer on the counter, slices a lemon in half, and twists it on the juicer to squeeze the juice.
Making a lemonade.middle: Juice collects as half after half is squeezed, then the person strains it into the pitcher, spoons in sugar, and pours cold water most of the way up.
Making a lemonade.end: The person stirs until the sugar dissolves, drops in ice cubes and floats thin lemon slices, then pours a glass and takes a first sip.
Making a lemonade.global: A person making a lemonade squeezes fresh lemons with a juicer and stirs the juice with sugar, water, and ice in a pitcher.

Making a sandwich.start: A person lays two bread slices on a cutting board beside assorted fillings, spreads one with butter or mayonnaise, and layers ham and cheese neatly on top.
Making a sandwich.middle: The person adds lettuce leaves, arranges thin tomato rounds over them, sprinkles salt and pepper, and presses the second bread slice on top of the stack.
Making a sandwich.end: Holding the sandwich steady, the person cuts it diagonally into halves, arranges them on a plate cut sides out, and lifts one half for a bite.
Making a sandwich.global: A person making a sandwich layers meat, cheese, lettuce, and tomato between bread slices, then cuts the finished stack diagonally in half.

Making an omelette.start: A person cracks several eggs into a bowl beside the stove, beats them smooth with a fork, and whisks in a pinch of salt and pepper.
Making an omelette.middle: Butter foams in the heated pan, the eggs pour in with a sizzle, and the person stirs gently and lifts the setting edges so runny egg flows underneath.
Making an omelette.end: The person sprinkles cheese and fillings over one half, folds the omelette over with the spatula, and slides it golden and lightly browned onto a plate.
Making an omelette.global: A person making an omelette beats eggs, cooks them in a buttered pan, and folds the filled golden result onto a plate.

Mixing drinks.start: A person lines up bottles, a shaker, and glasses on the bar counter, scoops in ice cubes, and pours a measured spirit from a jigger over the ice.
Mixing drinks.middle: The person adds measured juice and syrup, caps the shaker firmly, and shakes it vigorously beside the shoulder until frost forms on the cold metal.
Mixing drinks.end: The person strains the chilled drink into a waiting glass, adds a garnish to the rim, slides the finished cocktail forward, and wipes the counter clean.
Mixing drinks.global: A person mixing drinks at a bar counter measures spirits and juices over ice, shakes the sealed shaker hard, and strains a garnished cocktail into a glass.

Mooping floor.start: A person fills a bucket with water and cleaning solution, soaks the mop head in it, and squeezes out the excess through the wringer.
Mooping floor.middle: The damp mop swings side to side in wide overlapping arcs, leaving a wet sheen as the person works backward across the room strip by strip.
Mooping floor.end: The person scrubs stubborn spots with short hard strokes, mops the final corner, stands the mop in the bucket, and carries it away as the clean floor dries.
Mooping floor.global: A person mopping the floor at home swings a damp mop in overlapping arcs, rinsing and wringing it in a bucket until the floor glistens clean.

Mowing the lawn.start: A person wheels a mower onto an overgrown lawn, pulls the starter cord until the engine rattles to life, and pushes it forward into the tall grass.
Mowing the lawn.middle: The mower cuts clean strips with clippings spraying out as the person turns at each edge and pushes back along overlapping parallel passes across the lawn.
Mowing the lawn.end: The person empties the grass catcher into a waste bag, mows the final strip around the flower bed, then shuts off the engine and surveys the striped lawn.
Mowing the lawn.global: A person mowing the lawn pushes a rattling mower in parallel strips across overgrown grass until the whole yard is evenly cut.

Paintball.start: Masked players in padded gear spread across a field dotted with bunkers, sprint to cover at the signal, and crouch with markers ready.
Paintball.middle: A player leans out to fire streaking paintballs, ducks as return shots splatter the bunker, dashes low to closer cover, and teammates signal and lay covering fire.
Paintball.end: The player flanks wide and hits an exposed opponent, who raises a hand and walks off, and the remaining players advance to claim the objective.
Paintball.global: Masked players compete in paintball on a bunker-dotted field, darting between cover and firing paint-filled rounds until opponents are marked out.

Painting.start: A person spreads a drop cloth along a bare wall, stirs paint and pours it into a roller tray, and cuts in the edges with a small brush.
Painting.middle: The person coats the roller in the tray and rolls paint onto the wall in long overlapping vertical strokes, reloading between passes and blending each section.
Painting.end: The person smooths a drip with a quick brush pass, steps back to check for thin patches, and cleans the roller as the wall wears an even coat.
Painting.global: A person painting an interior wall rolls fresh color in overlapping strokes, brushing the edges until the surface carries an even coat.

Painting fence.start: A person carries paint and brushes to a weathered wooden fence, stirs the opened can until uniform, and dips the brush, tapping it against the rim.
Painting fence.middle: The person strokes paint down plank after plank in long vertical passes, working color into the gray grain and crouching to coat the lower boards near the grass.
Painting fence.end: The person paints the horizontal rails, touches up drips and a missed patch with short strokes, then seals the can as the fresh fence gleams evenly.
Painting fence.global: A person painting a fence brushes fresh color onto weathered wooden planks one by one until the whole fence line is evenly coated.

Painting furniture.start: A person sets an old wooden chair on a drop cloth, sands its surfaces to dull the finish, and wipes away the dust until the wood is clean.
Painting furniture.middle: The person stirs the paint, then brushes smooth even strokes along the backrest, over the seat with the grain, and down each leg to its foot.
Painting furniture.end: The person brushes carefully around the rungs and undersides, adds a second coat over thin areas once the first dries, then steps back and cleans the brush.
Painting furniture.global: A person painting furniture sands an old wooden chair, then brushes fresh coats of paint over every surface until it looks renewed.

Peeling potatoes.start: A person sits at a kitchen table with a bowl of unpeeled potatoes and slides the peeler along one, lifting a thin ribbon of skin.
Peeling potatoes.middle: The person rotates the potato after each stroke as peels curl into a pile, digs out the eyes with the peeler's tip, and drops it into clean water.
Peeling potatoes.end: The person repeats the quick practiced strokes on potato after potato until the last is peeled, then rinses their hands and pushes the peelings together.
Peeling potatoes.global: A person peeling potatoes at a kitchen table strips ribbons of skin with a handheld peeler, filling a bowl of water with pale smooth potatoes.

Ping-pong.start: Two players stand at opposite table ends, and the server tosses the ball and strikes it over the low net with a paddle.
Ping-pong.middle: The players trade quick forehand and backhand strokes low over the net, one adding topspin while the other lifts higher arcing defensive returns.
Ping-pong.end: The attacker smashes the high ball downward past the defender's outstretched paddle, and both players relax and reset for the next serve.
Ping-pong.global: In a game of ping-pong, two players rally a small ball across a table with paddles, exchanging rapid strokes over a low net.

Plastering.start: A worker mixes plaster to a smooth paste, scoops a mound onto a hawk board, and loads the trowel blade with a strip.
Plastering.middle: Sweeping upward strokes spread thick bands of plaster over the wall, overlapping passes filling hollows while the tilted trowel flattens ridges and feathers the edges.
Plastering.end: Long smoothing strokes level the coat, light passes polish the firming plaster to a matte finish, and the worker inspects the freshly plastered wall.
Plastering.global: A worker performs plastering indoors, repeatedly spreading and smoothing wet plaster from a hawk board over a bare wall with a trowel.

Plataform diving.start: A diver climbs the tower, stands motionless at the platform's edge with arms overhead, then bends the knees and swings the arms for takeoff.
Plataform diving.middle: The diver springs upward from the rigid platform, pulls into a tight tuck, rotates through fast somersaults, then kicks out into a straight vertical line.
Plataform diving.end: With arms extended and hands clasped, the diver knifes into the water almost vertically with a small splash, then surfaces beside the pool wall.
Plataform diving.global: In platform diving, an athlete leaps from a high rigid platform, somersaults through the air, and enters the pool vertically with minimal splash.

Playing accordion.start: A musician straps the accordion against the chest, places hands on the keyboard and bass buttons, and draws the bellows open for the first chord.
Playing accordion.middle: The right hand picks out the melody while the left presses bass buttons in rhythm, the bellows squeezing and pulling in flowing cycles as the player sways.
Playing accordion.end: Fast right-hand runs ripple over the keys, the bellows stretch wide for a final crescendo, then ease shut on the last chord.
Playing accordion.global: A musician is playing accordion, pumping the bellows against the chest while fingers work the piano keys and bass buttons in flowing rhythm.

Playing badminton.start: Two players face each other across a high net, and the server strikes the shuttlecock with an underarm swing, arcing it toward the receiver.
Playing badminton.middle: The players exchange high clears and shuffle to cover the corners, one tapping a soft drop shot while the opponent sprints in and flicks the shuttle high.
Playing badminton.end: One player leaps and smashes the shuttlecock steeply downward, it strikes the floor inside the line, and both walk back to serve again.
Playing badminton.global: Two players are playing badminton on an indoor court, rallying a shuttlecock over a high net with rapid racket swings and quick footwork.

Playing bagpipes.start: A piper settles the bag under the left arm, blows steadily through the blowpipe to inflate it, and the drones hum to life.
Playing bagpipes.middle: The elbow squeezes the bag as fingers lift and drop on the chanter, flicking rapid grace notes while steady blowing keeps the pressure constant.
Playing bagpipes.end: The piper steps into a slow march as the tune builds over humming drones, then stops blowing and lets the bag deflate into silence.
Playing bagpipes.global: A piper stands outdoors playing bagpipes, squeezing the inflated bag under one arm while fingering the chanter beneath sustained droning notes.

Playing beach volleyball.start: Barefoot players stand on a sand court, and the server tosses the ball and strikes it overhead while a defender bumps it up with joined forearms.
Playing beach volleyball.middle: A teammate sets the ball high with open fingertips, the hitter leaps from the sand and spikes it downward, and an opposing blocker jumps with stretched arms.
Playing beach volleyball.end: A defender dives to dig the deflected ball, the rally continues until it drops onto open sand, and players slap hands and rotate.
Playing beach volleyball.global: Teams are playing beach volleyball on an outdoor sand court, bumping, setting, and spiking the ball over the net with airborne leaps.

Playing blackjack.start: Players seated around a curved casino table slide chip stacks into betting circles, and the dealer deals two face-up cards to each player.
Playing blackjack.middle: The dealer tucks a hole card face down, and players tap the felt for extra cards or wave flat hands to stand in turn.
Playing blackjack.end: The dealer flips the hole card, draws until the house reaches seventeen, then pays winning bets with chips and sweeps losing stacks away.
Playing blackjack.global: Players sit around a casino table playing blackjack, betting chips and signaling for cards while the dealer deals hands and settles the bets.

Playing congas.start: A percussionist stands behind two upright conga drums, hands beginning a slow pattern of crisp open tones while the right hand keeps a steady pulse.
Playing congas.middle: Sharp slaps and deep bass tones alternate as both hands weave open tones and muted touches into a rolling groove, shoulders bouncing with the rhythm.
Playing congas.end: A rapid flurry of strokes blurs across both drums, the groove settles back to even palm strokes, and a final accented slap ends the rhythm.
Playing congas.global: A percussionist is playing congas, striking two upright drums with alternating palms and fingertips in a repeating pattern of slaps and bass tones.

Playing drums.start: A drummer sits behind the kit with a stick in each hand, taps a count on the hi-hat, and thumps the kick pedal on downbeats.
Playing drums.middle: Snare backbeats and ticking hi-hat lock into a steady rock groove, and a fill rolls across the mounted toms from high drum to floor tom.
Playing drums.end: The drummer crashes a cymbal and drops back into the groove, building louder strokes until a final crash is caught to silence the kit.
Playing drums.global: A drummer is playing drums on a full kit, driving a steady groove with sticks on snare, cymbals, and toms over a pumping kick pedal.

Playing field hockey.start: Players spread across a turf pitch with sticks low, and one taps the ball forward, dribbling it side to side with the curved stick head.
Playing field hockey.middle: A crouched defender jabs for the ball while the attacker pushes a flat pass to a teammate, who controls it and drives a low shot toward goal.
Playing field hockey.end: The padded goalkeeper kicks the shot away, players scramble with clashing sticks for the rebound, and a follow-up shot slips under the keeper.
Playing field hockey.global: Teams are playing field hockey on an outdoor turf pitch, dribbling and passing a small ball with curved sticks toward the goal.

Playing flauta.start: A musician holds the slender flute horizontally to the right side, sets the lower lip on the plate, and blows across the mouthpiece hole.
Playing flauta.middle: Fingers press and release the keys in fluttering runs while the player breathes between phrases, the head tilting as the flute rises and dips.
Playing flauta.end: The player sustains a high note with firmed lips, descends through soft breathy notes, and lowers the flute as the final note fades.
Playing flauta.global: A musician is playing the flute, holding it horizontally and blowing across the mouthpiece while fingers move rapidly over the keys.

Playing guitarra.start: A guitarist sits with the guitar on one thigh, presses the first chord shape on the frets, and strums down across the strings.
Playing guitarra.middle: Steady down-and-up strumming continues while the left hand slides between chord shapes and the right-hand fingers begin picking single strings in melodic patterns.
Playing guitarra.end: A run of single notes climbs the neck, the strumming softens to light brushes, and a flat palm damps the strings into silence.
Playing guitarra.global: A person is playing the guitar, fretting chords with one hand while the other strums and picks the strings over the sound hole.

Playing harmonica.start: A player cups a small harmonica between both palms, seals the lips over a few holes, and notes rise and fall with blowing and drawing breaths.
Playing harmonica.middle: The harmonica slides along the lips between holes while cupped hands open and close for a wah effect and bent notes dip in rhythmic chugging passages.
Playing harmonica.end: The head tilts back on a long trembling high note, the melody eases into softer phrases, and the player lowers the harmonica, exhaling.
Playing harmonica.global: A person is playing harmonica, cupping the small instrument at the mouth and breathing in and out to bend notes and shape the melody.

Playing ice hockey.start: Helmeted skaters glide across the rink with sticks low, and one wins the puck along the boards and weaves upfield with quick crossovers.
Playing ice hockey.middle: Flat passes snap across the ice as defenders angle the carrier wide, a winger snaps a wrist shot, and the goaltender drops into a butterfly.
Playing ice hockey.end: Players battle in the crease for the rebound, a forward jams the puck past the sprawling goaltender, and scorers raise their sticks in celebration.
Playing ice hockey.global: Teams are playing ice hockey on a rink, skating in pads while passing and shooting a puck with sticks toward a defended net.

Playing kickball.start: Players take positions on a base diamond, the pitcher rolls a large rubber ball toward home plate, and the kicker strides forward to swing a leg.
Playing kickball.middle: The ball booms off the foot over the infielders, the kicker sprints down the baseline, and an outfielder scoops the bounce and throws toward the infield.
Playing kickball.end: A fielder stretches to tag the sliding runner, who pops up safe as teammates cheer, and the next kicker steps to the plate.
Playing kickball.global: Players are playing kickball on an outdoor diamond, kicking a rolled rubber ball and sprinting around bases while fielders chase and throw it.

Playing lacrosse.start: Helmeted players spread across a grass field with long netted sticks, one scooping a ground ball and cradling it in the mesh pocket.
Playing lacrosse.middle: The carrier sprints upfield dodging checks, flings an overhand pass to a cutting teammate, and defenders slap and poke with their sticks near the crease.
Playing lacrosse.end: The attacker whips the stick forward, firing a shot that snaps past the goalkeeper into the net, and teammates converge to celebrate the goal.
Playing lacrosse.global: Players are playing lacrosse on an outdoor field, running while cradling a ball in netted sticks and passing and shooting at a goal.

Playing piano.start: A pianist settles onto the bench, lifts the fallboard, and begins the melody with the right hand over quiet left-hand supporting chords.
Playing piano.middle: Fingers stride across the keys with the sustain pedal ringing harmonies together, hands crossing through rippling ascending runs as the pianist leans into softer passages.
Playing piano.end: Both hands strike full chords toward the climax, the tempo eases into gentle arpeggios, and the final chord fades as hands lift from the keys.
Playing piano.global: A pianist is playing piano at a keyboard, fingers moving continuously across white and black keys while a foot works the sustain pedal.

Playing polo.start: Riders on ponies carry long-handled mallets onto a grass field, and when the ball is bowled in, one leans from the saddle to swing at it.
Playing polo.middle: Riders gallop after the skipping ball, striking forehand shots downfield while opponents bump shoulder to shoulder and hook mallet swings to knock it loose.
Playing polo.end: A rider taps controlled strokes at a gallop toward goal, sends the ball rolling between the tall posts, and the ponies wheel back to midfield.
Playing polo.global: Mounted riders are playing polo on a wide grass field, galloping on ponies and swinging long mallets to drive a ball toward goal.

Playing pool.start: A player racks the colored balls into a tight triangle, chalks the cue tip, and leans over the table sliding the cue through a bridge hand.
Playing pool.middle: The break scatters balls across the green cloth, and the player circles the table, pocketing balls with smooth low strokes and lining up the next shot.
Playing pool.end: A gentle touch shot drops a ball into the side pocket, and the player keeps clearing the table until the final ball falls.
Playing pool.global: A player is playing pool indoors, leaning over a green table and stroking a cue to pocket colored balls while an opponent watches.

Playing racquetball.start: Two players in eye guards take positions in an enclosed court, and the server bounces the ball and strikes it toward the front wall.
Playing racquetball.middle: The rally quickens with the ball ricocheting off front and side walls, one player taking it early at center court while ceiling shots push the opponent deep.
Playing racquetball.end: The opponent digs the ball from the back corner, but a crisp kill shot dies low against the front wall, and both players reset.
Playing racquetball.global: Two players are playing racquetball inside an enclosed court, swinging rackets to drive a small ball off the front wall in fast rallies.

Playing rubik cube.start: A solver holds a scrambled Rubik's cube in both hands, tilting it through inspection turns before fingers begin twisting layers with quick clicking rotations.
Playing rubik cube.middle: Thumbs and fingers flick the layers through practiced sequences as a white cross forms, corners pair up, and matching colors spread layer by layer.
