Playing rubik cube.end: The solver reads the final pattern, spins a last rapid algorithm to align the remaining edges, and holds up the cube with solid-colored faces.
Playing rubik cube.global: A person is playing with a Rubik's cube, rapidly twisting its layers with both hands until every face becomes a single solid color.

Playing saxophone.start: A saxophonist stands with the curved brass horn on a neck strap, sets the mouthpiece between the lips, and blooms out the first low note.
Playing saxophone.middle: The melody unwinds in smooth phrases as fingers pad the key stacks, quick runs tumbling down the horn while the player sways with the groove.
Playing saxophone.end: A long wailing high note holds with tight cheeks, the solo softens into breathier phrases, and the final note tapers as the horn swings on its strap.
Playing saxophone.global: A musician is playing saxophone, swaying with the curved brass instrument hanging from a neck strap while fingers ripple over the keys.

Playing squash.start: Two players face the high front wall of an enclosed court, and the server strikes the ball above the service line into the opposite back quarter.
Playing squash.middle: Both players drive the small black ball to the front wall in turns, hitting tight rail shots and lunging from the center T for retrievals.
Playing squash.end: After a sprinting retrieval of a drop shot, a hard low kill leaves the ball bouncing twice, and the players circle back to serve again.
Playing squash.global: Two players are playing squash in an enclosed indoor court, taking turns driving a small black ball against the high front wall.

Playing ten pins.start: A bowler stands at the approach sighting the ten pins, settles fingers into the drilled holes, and steps forward swinging the ball in a pendulum arc.
Playing ten pins.middle: Released low onto the lane, the ball hooks toward the head pin and strikes the pocket, leaving two corner pins standing as it rolls off.
Playing ten pins.end: The bowler retrieves the returned ball, rolls a second shot that clips the remaining pins cleanly down, and turns away with a fist pump.
Playing ten pins.global: A bowler is playing ten-pin bowling indoors, swinging a heavy ball down a polished lane in repeated attempts to knock over the pins.

Playing violin.start: A violinist tucks the instrument between chin and shoulder, sets the bow hair on the strings, and draws a warm first note near the bridge.
Playing violin.middle: Left-hand fingers shape the melody along the fingerboard with rolling vibrato while the bow rocks between strings and bounces through crisp quick passages.
Playing violin.end: The left hand shifts to bright high positions, sweeping bow strokes carry the melody to its peak, and the bow lifts as the final note fades.
Playing violin.global: A musician is playing violin at the shoulder, drawing a bow across the strings while left-hand fingers press and shift along the fingerboard.

Playing water polo.start: Players tread water between floating goals with churning eggbeater kicks, and the goalkeeper lobs the ball out to a teammate's raised hand.
Playing water polo.middle: Field players whip one-handed passes above the surface while defenders stretch arms high to block, and a wet pass drops ahead of a driving attacker.
Playing water polo.end: The attacker rises from the water and whips a one-handed shot that skips past the lunging goalkeeper into the net, and play restarts at center.
Playing water polo.global: Teams are playing water polo in a deep pool, treading water and throwing the ball one-handed toward floating goals past pressing defenders.

Pole vault.start: A vaulter grips the long pole high with both hands, sprints down the runway with the tip angled up, and plants it into the metal box.
Pole vault.middle: The vaulter swings off the ground as the pole bends deeply, rocks back with hips above shoulders, and is hurled upward feet first as it recoils.
Pole vault.end: The body arches over the crossbar in a curved pike, the vaulter releases the pole and falls away, landing back-first on the padded mat.
Pole vault.global: In the pole vault, an athlete sprints down a runway carrying a long pole, plants it, and is flung high over a crossbar onto padding.

Polishing forniture.start: A person wipes dust from a wooden tabletop with a dry cloth, then sprays a light mist of polish across the wood's surface.
Polishing forniture.middle: A folded cloth rubs the polish in slow overlapping circles along the grain, pressing firmly over dull patches and tracing the legs and carved edges.
Polishing forniture.end: A clean side of the cloth buffs the tabletop with brisk light strokes until reflections sharpen, and the person steps back admiring the shine.
Polishing forniture.global: A person is polishing furniture at home, rubbing polish over a wooden table in repetitive circular strokes with a cloth until it gleams.

Polishing shoes.start: A person sits with a leather shoe in hand, brushes off loose dirt, and gathers a dab of polish from an open tin onto a cloth.
Polishing shoes.middle: The cloth rubs polish into the leather in small circles from toe to heel, the wax hazes, and a horsehair brush whips back and forth buffing.
Polishing shoes.end: A soft cloth snaps side to side over the toe cap raising a mirror gloss, and the finished shoe is set aside for the second one.
Polishing shoes.global: A person is polishing shoes at home, brushing and rubbing polish into the leather with repetitive strokes until a glossy shine appears.

Powerbocking.start: An athlete straps curved spring stilts below the knees, stands balancing with arms out, and takes first gentle bouncing steps along the pavement.
Powerbocking.middle: Strides lengthen into loping bounds and a springing run, then hard double-leg pushes launch the athlete high into the air with knees tucking at the peak.
Powerbocking.end: The athlete lands on the flexing stilts and rebounds into further leaps before a final high bounce ends in a controlled two-footed stop.
Powerbocking.global: An athlete is powerbocking on urban pavement, bouncing and leaping high into the air on curved spring stilts strapped to both legs.

Preparing pasta.start: A cook heats a large pot of salted water on the stove to a rolling boil and slides dry pasta into the bubbling water.
Preparing pasta.middle: The cook stirs the pasta with a long spoon while sauce simmers in a separate pan, tests a strand for bite, and drains the pot into a colander.
Preparing pasta.end: The drained pasta is tossed in the sauce pan, twirled into a mounded bowl, and finished with grated cheese before heading to the table.
Preparing pasta.global: A cook is preparing pasta in a home kitchen, boiling and stirring noodles, simmering sauce, and tossing them together before serving.

Preparing salad.start: A cook rinses lettuce and vegetables under running water, shakes the leaves dry, tears them into a bowl, and slices a tomato into wedges.
Preparing salad.middle: The knife slices cucumber rounds and chops onion and pepper into strips, the cut vegetables are scraped onto the greens, and dressing is whisked in a cup.
Preparing salad.end: The dressing drizzles over the salad in a circling stream, two large spoons toss everything until glistening, and portions are plated with ground pepper.
Preparing salad.global: A cook is preparing salad in a home kitchen, washing and chopping fresh vegetables into a bowl and tossing them with whisked dressing.

Putting in contact lenses.start: A person washes and dries both hands at the bathroom mirror, lifts a soft lens from the case, and balances it on an index fingertip.
Putting in contact lenses.middle: After rinsing the lens with solution, the person pulls the lower eyelid down, holds the upper lashes up, and brings the lens slowly toward the open eye.
Putting in contact lenses.end: The lens settles onto the eye's surface, the person blinks several times to center it, then repeats the steps for the other eye.
Putting in contact lenses.global: A person is putting in contact lenses before a bathroom mirror, delicately placing a soft lens from a fingertip onto each widened eye.

Putting on makeup.start: A person sits before a lighted mirror, blending foundation across the cheeks with a damp sponge and tapping concealer smooth under the eyes.
Putting on makeup.middle: Loose powder sets the base, eyeshadow sweeps and blends across the lids, eyeliner traces the lash line, and the mascara wand combs upward through the lashes.
Putting on makeup.end: A blush brush swirls color onto the cheeks, lipstick glides across the lips and is blotted, and the person checks both profiles in the mirror.
Putting on makeup.global: A person is putting on makeup before a lighted mirror, applying foundation, eye products, blush, and lipstick with fine strokes of held applicators.

Putting on shoes.start: A person sits on a chair, loosens the laces of the first shoe, and slides the toes into the opening while steadying the heel.
Putting on shoes.middle: A finger hooks the heel to ease the foot down, the toe taps the floor to settle it, and the laces pull snug row by row.
Putting on shoes.end: Fingers tie a firm two-loop bow, the second shoe goes on and is tied the same way, and the person stands and steps away.
Putting on shoes.global: A person sits at home putting on shoes, sliding each foot inside, tightening the laces, and tying them into firm bows.

Rafting.start: A helmeted group in life jackets carries an inflatable raft to the river, climbs aboard, and digs paddles in together on the guide's command.
Rafting.middle: The crew paddles in matched rhythm into the current, and the raft bucks through white water with spray bursting over the bow as the guide shouts.
Rafting.end: The crew throws their weight high as the raft tilts against a rock, punches through the last wave, and taps paddles together overhead in celebration.
Rafting.global: A group goes rafting down a river in an inflatable boat, paddling together through churning white-water rapids under a guide's commands.

Raking leaves.start: A person carries a wide fan rake across a leaf-scattered lawn and pulls steady sweeps of leaves inward, clearing green stripes of grass.
Raking leaves.middle: Working across the yard in rows, the person merges smaller piles into one growing central mound, flipping the rake to herd stray drifting leaves.
Raking leaves.end: Armfuls of leaves are clamped and stuffed into a large yard bag, which is pressed down and tied off as the rake leans against the fence.
Raking leaves.global: A person is raking leaves in an outdoor yard, dragging repetitive strokes of a fan rake to gather fallen leaves into piles for bagging.

Removing curlers.start: A person sits facing a mirror with hair wound in plastic curlers, unsnapping a clip and gently unwinding the first wrapped strand of hair.
Removing curlers.middle: The hands move along the rows, unclipping and unrolling one curler after another as loosened coils of hair tumble down around the shoulders.
Removing curlers.end: Fingertips rake gently through the freed curls, scrunching and shaping them around the face before a final mirror check as empty curlers are cleared away.
Removing curlers.global: A person sits at a mirror removing curlers, unclipping and unwinding plastic rollers one by one to release soft coils of hair.

Removing ice from car.start: A driver approaches a frost-sealed car, starts the engine with the defroster switched on, and brushes loose snow off the roof and hood.
Removing ice from car.middle: The plastic scraper bites into the windshield ice at a low angle, shaving curls with short firm strokes in overlapping bands across the glass and side windows.
Removing ice from car.end: The rear window is scraped clear, wipers flick away remaining slush as the defroster clears the fog, and the driver tosses the scraper inside.
Removing ice from car.global: A driver is removing ice from a car in a snowy setting, scraping repetitive strokes across the frozen windows with a handheld tool.

Riding bumper cars.start: Riders line up beside a shiny arena floor, climb into small bumper cars, buckle lap belts, and creep forward as poles spark against the ceiling grid.
Riding bumper cars.middle: The rider presses the pedal and spins the small wheel, colliding head-on with rubbery thumps, reversing away, and chasing other cars in laughing loops.
Riding bumper cars.end: A broadside hit spins the car against the rail, the rider weaves through the crowd, and the power cuts as cars glide to a stop.
Riding bumper cars.global: People are riding bumper cars in an amusement arena, steering small electric cars into laughing collisions under a sparking ceiling grid.

River tubing.start: A group carries large inflated tubes to a wide river, plops backward into them, and drifts off the shallows into the gently spinning current.
River tubing.middle: Riders lie back with arms draped over the tubes and feet dangling, paddling lazily until a quickening riffle bounces them whooping through small waves.
River tubing.end: The river flattens and friends link tubes into a floating raft, one spinning slow circles, before the group paddles ashore at the takeout.
River tubing.global: A group goes river tubing on moving water, floating downstream in large inflated tubes and bobbing through gentle rapids together.

Rock climbing.start: A climber cinches a harness at the base of a rock face, ties in with a figure-eight knot, chalks both hands, and grips the first holds.
Rock climbing.middle: The climber presses feet onto small edges and reaches for sloping holds, clipping the rope into quickdraws and smearing through a tricky slow section.
Rock climbing.end: After shaking out on a ledge and re-chalking, a final powerful pull reaches the top anchor, and the climber is lowered smoothly down the rope.
Rock climbing.global: A climber is rock climbing an outdoor face, gripping holds and pressing on small edges while ascending on a rope toward the top anchor.

Rock-paper-scissors.start: Two people face each other with fists held out, pumping them up and down in rhythm until both hands snap open into chosen shapes.
Rock-paper-scissors.middle: Paper covers rock in the first round, the fists reload and bounce in unison, and scissors cut paper to even the score.
Rock-paper-scissors.end: In the deciding round the players eye each other as fists pump, then a final rock crushes scissors and the winner throws both arms up.
Rock-paper-scissors.global: Two people play rock-paper-scissors face to face, pumping their fists in unison and snapping them open into competing hand shapes each round.

Rollerblading.start: A skater buckles inline skates on a bench, rolls onto the smooth path, and pushes the first strokes outward with one skate gliding.
Rollerblading.middle: The stride settles into rhythm with arms swinging low, the skater bending deeper for speed and crossing one skate over the other through a bend.
Rollerblading.end: The skater weaves around walkers, hops a crack, then drags the heel brake steadily and glides to an upright, relaxed stop.
Rollerblading.global: A skater goes rollerblading along an outdoor urban path, pushing rhythmic strides on inline skates and carving smooth turns at speed.

Roof shingle removal.start: A gloved worker climbs a ladder onto a sloped roof and slides a flat shingle fork under the top course, prying the first shingles loose.
Roof shingle removal.middle: Moving backward down the roof, the worker levers row after row free, popping stubborn nails and peeling felt underlayment to expose the bare wooden deck.
Roof shingle removal.end: Debris and stray nails are swept down the slope, the last course at the eave is pried off, and the worker scans the stripped deck.
Roof shingle removal.global: A worker performs roof shingle removal on a sloped roof, prying old shingles loose with a fork tool and shoving them into a dumpster.

Rope skipping.start: A jumper holds a rope handle in each hand, flicks the wrists to swing it overhead, and hops as the rope passes under the feet.
Rope skipping.middle: The swings settle into a steady ticking rhythm with small springy bounces, the wrists spinning faster until the rope blurs around alternating running steps.
Rope skipping.end: The arms thread a crossover in front of the body, a burst of double-unders whips the rope twice per jump, and it catches at the feet.
Rope skipping.global: A person performs rope skipping, repeatedly jumping in place as a handheld rope whirls overhead and ticks under the feet.

Running a marathon.start: A dense crowd of runners packs the starting corrals, surges over the timing mats at the horn, and spreads along the city streets.
Running a marathon.middle: Runners click off miles in even rhythm, grabbing water cups mid-stride past cheering spectators, their strides shortening with effort by the midway point.
Running a marathon.end: In the late miles some runners grimace and slow, then the field digs into a final surge and crosses the finish line as medals are draped on.
Running a marathon.global: A large crowd of athletes is running a marathon through city streets, striding steadily past water stations and spectators toward the finish arch.

Sailing.start: A crew boards a sailboat at the dock, hoists the flapping mainsail up the mast, and unrolls the jib as the boat noses away.
Sailing.middle: The sails fill with wind as the crew winches the sheets tight, the boat heeling while crew members sit out on the windward rail.
Sailing.end: The helmsman tacks the bow through the wind, the boom swings across as the crew ducks and shifts sides, and the boat settles onto its new course.
Sailing.global: A crew goes sailing aboard a boat on open water, hoisting and trimming the sails and tacking through the wind together.

Scuba diving.start: A diver straps on tank, vest, mask, and fins aboard the boat, takes a giant stride off the edge, and vents air to begin descending.
Scuba diving.middle: Equalizing the ears, the diver fin-kicks slowly down toward the reef with bubbles streaming, then hovers and glides above the coral watching fish drift past.
Scuba diving.end: After checking gauges and signaling a buddy, the diver ascends slowly with a safety stop, surfaces, inflates the vest, and swims to the boat.
Scuba diving.global: A diver goes scuba diving underwater, breathing from a tank and swimming with slow fin kicks along a coral reef.

Sharpening knives.start: A person wets a whetstone on the counter, then rests the knife blade against it at a shallow, consistent angle.
Sharpening knives.middle: The person draws the blade across the stone in sweeping strokes, flipping it to alternate sides rhythmically before polishing the edge on a finer stone.
Sharpening knives.end: The person wipes the blade clean, tests the edge by slicing paper cleanly, then rinses the stone and dries the knife.
Sharpening knives.global: A person is sharpening knives by drawing a blade across a wet whetstone in steady alternating strokes at a kitchen counter.

Shaving.start: A man splashes warm water on his face at a bathroom mirror, spreads white shaving foam over his cheeks, and raises a razor to taut skin.
Shaving.middle: The man draws the razor down his cheeks, jawline, and upper lip in short smooth strokes, rinsing the blade in the sink between passes.
Shaving.end: The man shaves up his neck to clear the last lather, splashes water over his face, and pats his smooth cheeks dry with a towel.
Shaving.global: A man stands shaving at a bathroom mirror, drawing a razor through white foam on his cheeks, jaw, and neck in repeated strokes.

Shaving legs.start: A woman sits at the bathtub's edge, wets one extended leg, spreads shaving gel from ankle to knee, and glides a razor upward in one slow stroke.
Shaving legs.middle: The woman rinses the razor and continues parallel upward strokes along her shin, shaving carefully around the bent knee and along the calf.
Shaving legs.end: The woman repeats the strokes on her other leg with fresh gel, rinses both legs clean, then towels them dry and smooths on lotion.
Shaving legs.global: A woman sits at a bathtub shaving legs, gliding a razor upward through white gel lather from ankle to knee in repeated strokes.

Shot put.start: The athlete steps into the throwing circle cradling the metal shot at the neck, crouches over the right leg, and glides backward in a low hop.
Shot put.middle: Landing in the power position, the athlete drives hips and chest around, punching the arm out so the shot leaves the fingertips at an upward angle.
Shot put.end: The athlete reverses the feet to stay inside the circle while the shot arcs through the air, thuds into the grass, and the thrower walks out the back.
Shot put.global: An athlete performs a shot put, gliding across a throwing circle and pushing a heavy metal ball from the neck out over a grass field.

Shoveling snow.start: A person in a winter coat grips a wide shovel, pushes its blade into driveway snow, and drives it forward to peel up a thick layer.
Shoveling snow.middle: The person lifts loaded scoops and heaves snow onto a bank in steady rhythm, working parallel strips as the cleared pavement lengthens behind each stroke.
Shoveling snow.end: The person pauses to stretch with visible breath, scrapes the last thin patches to bare pavement, then taps the shovel clean and surveys the driveway.
Shoveling snow.global: A person in winter clothing is shoveling snow from a driveway, repeatedly scooping and tossing loads onto a bank beside the pavement.

Shuffleboard.start: Two players hold long-handled cues on a narrow court, and one fits the cue's forked head behind a weighted disc, sighting toward the distant scoring triangle.
Shuffleboard.middle: The player pushes the cue smoothly, sending the disc gliding into the scoring triangle, and the opponent's shot clacks against it to knock it away.
Shuffleboard.end: The players alternate deliveries as discs cluster and scatter around the triangle, then walk to the far end, tally each zone, and slide the discs back.
Shuffleboard.global: Two players play shuffleboard on a long indoor court, pushing weighted discs with long-handled cues toward a numbered scoring triangle.

Skateboarding.start: A skater pushes off the pavement with the back foot, then sets both feet on the deck and glides across the plaza with knees bent.
Skateboarding.middle: The skater carves an arc, snaps the tail down to ollie over a curb, levels the board mid-air, and bends the knees to absorb the landing.
Skateboarding.end: The skater pops onto a low ledge, slides briefly along it, drops back down, rolls out smoothly, and flips the board up into one hand.
Skateboarding.global: A skater goes skateboarding across a paved urban plaza, rolling, carving, and popping airborne tricks over curbs and ledges.

Skiing.start: A skier pushes off the slope top with both poles and settles into a crouch, parallel skis gliding downhill and picking up speed.
Skiing.middle: The skier plants poles and links rhythmic parallel turns, edges spraying snow as weight shifts ski to ski, leaving twin S-shaped tracks behind.
Skiing.end: The skier absorbs a terrain roll, tucks briefly on a straight fast section, then skids the skis sharply sideways to a stop in spraying snow.
Skiing.global: A skier descends a snow-covered slope skiing on parallel skis, carving linked turns with poles in hand and snow spraying from the edges.

Slacklining.start: A person presses one bare foot onto a taut webbing line stretched between two trees, then rises onto it with arms flung wide for balance.
Slacklining.middle: The person balances on the swaying line, arms waving in slow circles and hips countering wobbles, then places the trailing foot ahead and steps forward.
Slacklining.end: The person steps heel to toe along the bouncing line, crouches to ride out a larger swing, then reaches the far end and hops down onto the grass.
Slacklining.global: A person goes slacklining, balancing barefoot and stepping slowly along a flat webbing line stretched taut between two trees above the grass.

Smoking a cigarette.start: A person leaning against an outdoor wall taps a cigarette from its pack, places it between the lips, and lights the tip until it glows orange.
Smoking a cigarette.middle: The person draws on the cigarette so the ember brightens, exhales streams of gray smoke, and taps ash toward the ground between repeated drags.
Smoking a cigarette.end: The person takes a final drag as the ember flares near the filter, then drops the butt and crushes it out under a shoe.
Smoking a cigarette.global: A person stands outdoors smoking a cigarette, raising it to the mouth for repeated puffs and exhaling gray smoke between glances around.

Smoking hookah.start: A person places glowing charcoal on the foil-covered bowl of a tall hookah pipe, then draws on the hose mouthpiece as the water base bubbles.
Smoking hookah.middle: Thick white smoke bubbles up through the glass base as the person exhales a dense cloud and passes the hose to a friend who puffs in turn.
Smoking hookah.end: Smoke drifts in layers as the hose circles hand to hand, one person taps ash from the charcoal with tongs, and the group settles back as clouds thin.
Smoking hookah.global: A group lounges on cushions smoking hookah, sharing a hose from a tall water pipe and exhaling thick white clouds over a low table.

Snatch.start: A lifter takes a very wide overhand grip on a loaded barbell, back flat and hips low, then pulls it smoothly off the platform floor.
Snatch.middle: The lifter explosively extends hips and knees, pulls under the flying bar, and catches it on locked arms in a deep overhead squat.
Snatch.end: The lifter drives upward out of the squat to stand fully erect with the barbell motionless overhead, then drops it crashing to the platform.
Snatch.global: A lifter in a gym performs a snatch, pulling a loaded barbell from the floor to locked arms overhead in one explosive movement.

Snow tubing.start: A rider drags an inflatable tube to the top of a snow lane, sits into its round center gripping the handles, and drifts over the slope's lip.
Snow tubing.middle: The tube gathers speed down the groomed lane, spinning slowly and bouncing over a bump while the rider leans back with legs raised, gripping the handles.
Snow tubing.end: The lane flattens and the tube glides to a gentle rocking stop in the runout, where the rider rolls out and hauls it toward the lift line.
Snow tubing.global: A rider goes snow tubing, sliding down a groomed snow-covered lane seated in a large inflatable tube that spins and bounces during the descent.

Snowboarding.start: A snowboarder straps both boots onto a single board, rises sideways with arms out, and tips the board downhill to slide in a low stance.
Snowboarding.middle: The snowboarder links toe-side and heel-side carves down the run, spraying snow at each turn, then crouches and pops off a small mound into the air.
Snowboarding.end: The snowboarder floats briefly airborne with the board level, lands flat flexing the knees, and skids sideways to a stop in a spray of snow.
Snowboarding.global: A rider goes snowboarding down a snow-covered slope, carving linked turns on a single board and catching brief air off a small mound.

Spinning.start: Riders in a dim studio clip shoes into stationary bike pedals and settle into the saddle, matching the instructor's easy warm-up pace with smooth pedal circles.
Spinning.middle: The class twists resistance dials, rises out of the saddle to climb with swaying hips, then spins the legs rapidly through a counted sprint.
Spinning.end: The riders sit back to recover with lighter strokes, surge through another standing sprint to the music, then wind down stretching while still pedaling gently.
Spinning.global: A group takes a spinning class in a gym studio, pedaling stationary bikes through climbs and sprints as an instructor leads from the front.

Spread mulch.start: A gardener wheels a barrow of dark mulch to a planting bed, tips out a mound between the shrubs, and drives a shovel into the pile.
Spread mulch.middle: The gardener scatters shovelfuls across the bed, drops mulch around each plant, pushes it by hand close to tender stems, and rakes the layer smooth.
Spread mulch.end: The gardener pulls mulch back from each trunk to leave bare rings, empties another barrow onto the next section, and gives the bed a final even raking.
Spread mulch.global: A gardener works outdoors to spread mulch, shoveling and raking dark shredded material from a wheelbarrow into an even carpet across garden beds.

Springboard diving.start: A diver takes measured steps along the springboard, hops into the hurdle with one knee driving up, and lands on both feet at the board's tip.
Springboard diving.middle: The board recoils and hurls the diver upward, who folds into a tight spinning tuck, then kicks out straight high above the water.
Springboard diving.end: The diver stretches vertically with hands clasped, pierces the water hands first with a small splash, then surfaces and swims to the pool ladder.
Springboard diving.global: A diver performs springboard diving at a pool, bouncing off a flexing board into an airborne somersault before entering the water nearly splash-free.

Starting a campfire.start: A person kneels at a stone fire ring, mounds shredded tinder in the center, and leans thin kindling sticks into a small cone-shaped teepee.
Starting a campfire.middle: The person strikes a match, cups the flame against the breeze, touches it to the tinder, and blows gently until fire climbs the crackling kindling.
Starting a campfire.end: The person lays thicker branches over the young flames, friends gather in the flickering light, and a heavy log settles the campfire into a steady blaze.
Starting a campfire.global: A person is starting a campfire in a stone ring outdoors, building a kindling teepee over tinder and coaxing a match flame into a steady blaze.

Sumo.start: Two heavy wrestlers in belted loincloths squat behind white lines in a raised clay ring, then explode forward and collide chest to chest.
Sumo.middle: The wrestlers grapple for belt grips, one driving the other toward the straw boundary while the defender plants his feet, twists, and both strain with shuffling steps.
Sumo.end: One wrestler heaves the opponent off balance by the belt and shoves him stumbling over the ring's edge, and the referee points to the winner.
Sumo.global: Two heavy wrestlers fight a sumo bout in a raised circular clay ring, colliding and grappling for belt grips until one is forced out.

Surfing.start: A surfer paddles prone on a surfboard beyond the break, sprints toward shore ahead of a rising swell, and feels the wave lift the board's tail.
Surfing.middle: The surfer pops up into a sideways crouch, trims along the wave's open face, leans through a bottom turn, and snaps the board off the crumbling lip.
Surfing.end: Spray flies as the surfer carves down the wall pumping for speed, then straightens out as the wave closes and drops prone to paddle back out.
Surfing.global: A surfer goes surfing on open water, paddling into a wave, popping up to a crouch, and carving turns along its breaking face.

Swimming.start: A swimmer in cap and goggles dives from the pool's edge into the lane, gliding underwater in streamline before a flutter kick drives the body forward.
Swimming.middle: The swimmer surfaces into freestyle, arms wheeling in steady rhythm with breaths snatched to the side, then tucks into a flip turn at the wall.
Swimming.end: The swimmer pushes off in streamline with underwater dolphin kicks, drives down the return lap in churning white water, then touches the wall and stands.
Swimming.global: A swimmer in cap and goggles goes swimming in a pool lane, stroking freestyle in a steady cyclic rhythm between a dive and flip turns.

Swinging at the playground.start: A child backs onto a hanging swing seat, grips the two chains, pushes off the ground, and stretches the legs forward as the swing begins to arc.
Swinging at the playground.middle: The child pumps by tucking the legs on the backswing and extending them forward, the arc growing until the chains go light at the top.
Swinging at the playground.end: The child keeps a steady pumping rhythm, then lets the legs dangle so the arcs shorten, drags both feet in the dirt, and hops off.
Swinging at the playground.global: A child is swinging at the playground, gripping the chains of a hanging seat and pumping the legs to trace long rising arcs.

Table soccer.start: Two players grip the rod handles of a foosball table, one drops the ball through the serving hole, and rows of plastic figures kick at it.
Table soccer.middle: One player traps and dribbles the ball between figures, fires a wrist-flick shot at the goal, and the opponent's goalie figure blocks it with a clack.
Table soccer.end: Both players shuffle rods chasing the rebound until a snapped shot rattles into the goal slot and the scorer slides a bead along the counter.
Table soccer.global: Two players face off at table soccer, twisting and sliding rods so small plastic figures kick a ball toward each other's goal.

Tai chi.start: A group stands spaced apart in a park, bending the knees slightly and floating both arms slowly to shoulder height before pressing the palms gently down.
Tai chi.middle: The practitioners shift weight between legs, sweeping the hands in slow circles, stepping heel first with pushing palms, and rising into a gentle extended kick.
Tai chi.end: The group flows through a turning posture with arms sweeping like slow water, shifts weight side to side, then draws the feet together into stillness.
Tai chi.global: A group practices tai chi outdoors in a park, moving in unison through slow, flowing whole-body postures with unhurried breath.

Tango.start: A couple steps into a close embrace on a polished floor, hands clasped and extended, and begins a slow walk with long deliberate strides.
Tango.middle: The follower pivots through an ocho and flicks a leg sharply between steps as the couple rotates in tight turns, one leg extending into a low lunge.
Tango.end: The pair accelerates through quick gliding steps, the leader dips the follower arching back over his arm, and both draw upright into a still final pose.
Tango.global: A couple dances a tango on a polished stage floor, moving in close embrace through slow walks, pivots, flicks, and a dramatic dip.

Tennis serve with ball bouncing.start: A player behind the baseline bounces the ball repeatedly against the court, then catches it and rocks the weight back onto the rear foot.
Tennis serve with ball bouncing.middle: The player tosses the ball high, arches back with the racquet dropped behind the shoulders, then drives upward and strikes the ball with a sharp crack.
Tennis serve with ball bouncing.end: The racquet whips across the body as the ball rockets into the service box, and the player lands forward inside the baseline watching the return.
Tennis serve with ball bouncing.global: A player performs a tennis serve with ball bouncing, dribbling the ball at the baseline before tossing it up and striking it over the net.

Throwing darts.start: A player stands at the throw line facing a round wall board, raising one dart to eye level and sighting along its tip with elbow up.
Throwing darts.middle: The player cocks the dart beside the cheek, snaps the forearm forward to release it flat into the board, then repeats the measured aim with a second dart.
Throwing darts.end: The second dart strikes near the first and the third buries into the narrow scoring band, then the player tallies the score and pulls all three free.
Throwing darts.global: A player stands indoors throwing darts, repeatedly aiming and snapping small projectiles from behind a line into a round board on the wall.

Trimming branches or hedges.start: A gardener opens long-bladed shears before an overgrown hedge, snipping off protruding shoots and scissoring rhythmically along its face as clippings fall.
Trimming branches or hedges.middle: The gardener levels bulges with quick cuts, bites through a thick branch with hand pruners, and sweeps the shears in flat strokes across the hedge's top.
Trimming branches or hedges.end: Leaves spray from the blades as the gardener squares the far side with steady cuts, then rakes the fallen clippings into a heap beside the hedge.
Trimming branches or hedges.global: A gardener works in a garden trimming branches or hedges, making repeated fine cuts with shears and pruners until the greenery is squared.

Triple jump.start: An athlete sprints down a long runway with high driving knees, strikes the takeoff board, and launches forward into the hop phase.
Triple jump.middle: The athlete lands the hop on the takeoff foot, rebounds into a long-held step onto the other foot, and springs into the final jump over the sand pit.
Triple jump.end: The athlete stretches both legs forward mid-air, cuts heels into the sand folding past the mark, then climbs out and studies the raked landing marks.
Triple jump.global: An athlete performs a triple jump on an outdoor field, sprinting down the runway into a hop, step, and jump landing in the sand pit.

Tug of war.start: Two teams grip a thick rope on a grass field with bodies angled back, then heave at the signal so the rope snaps taut.
Tug of war.middle: Competitors lean far back with heels dug into the turf, the center ribbon twitching over the midline as one team surges and hauls it toward their side.
Tug of war.end: The anchors wrap the rope across their straining bodies until a final coordinated pull drags the ribbon past the marker, and the losers stumble forward as winners tumble back cheering.
Tug of war.global: Two teams compete at tug of war on a grass field, straining backward on a thick rope to drag a center ribbon past their marker.

Tumbling.start: A gymnast sprints down a long sprung strip, hurdles low, and whips through a round-off with hands to the floor and legs snapping together overhead.
Tumbling.middle: The gymnast rebounds through two rapid back handsprings, then punches off the floor into a high back somersault, tucking tightly with knees to the chest.
Tumbling.end: The gymnast opens out of the tuck spotting the floor, lands with feet together and knees bending, then stands extending both arms overhead to finish.
Tumbling.global: A gymnast performs tumbling down a sprung strip, chaining a round-off and back handsprings into an airborne tucked somersault and a controlled landing.

Using parallel bars.start: A gymnast grips the two rails, jumps into a straight-arm support, and begins swinging the legs forward and back beneath the shoulders.
Using parallel bars.middle: The swing grows until the gymnast presses into a momentary handstand, drops to an upper-arm hang beneath the bars, then whips back up to straight-arm support.
Using parallel bars.end: The gymnast swings another full pass with pointed toes, pushes off sideways releasing both bars at once, and lands on the mat with arms snapping up.
Using parallel bars.global: A gymnast performs a routine using parallel bars in a gym, swinging and pressing to handstand between two rails before dismounting to the mat.

Using the balance beam.start: A gymnast presses up onto a narrow raised beam, swings a leg over to mount, and rises to full height with arms extended sideways.
Using the balance beam.middle: The gymnast walks precisely along the beam, performs a split leap landing on one wobbling foot, then spins a full turn balanced on one toe.
Using the balance beam.end: The gymnast holds a pose with one leg extended along the beam, then strides to its end, punches into a somersaulting dismount, and lands with arms raised.
Using the balance beam.global: A gymnast performs a routine using the balance beam, walking, leaping, and turning along the narrow rail before an airborne somersaulting dismount.

Using the monkey bar.start: A child climbs a short ladder, grips the first overhead rung with both hands, and swings off the platform to hang freely beneath the row.
Using the monkey bar.middle: The child kicks the legs to build a swing and travels hand over hand along the rungs, pausing mid-span to reset the tiring grip.
Using the monkey bar.end: The child keeps rhythmic hand-over-hand swings to the final rung, then lets go and drops to the soft surface, bending the knees on landing.
Using the monkey bar.global: A child crosses a playground frame using the monkey bar, swinging hand over hand along overhead rungs with legs dangling below.

Using the pommel horse.start: A gymnast grips the two pommel handles, jumps to a locked-arm support, and sweeps the legs together into a first full circle around the horse.
Using the pommel horse.middle: The gymnast flows through continuous leg circles with hopping hand shifts, breaks into alternating scissors over the horse's ends, then returns to stretched double circles.
Using the pommel horse.end: The circles carry the gymnast sideways along the horse, who then swings the legs high toward a handstand and pivots off to land upright with arms raised.
Using the pommel horse.global: A gymnast performs a routine using the pommel horse, gripping its handles while sweeping continuous circular leg swings and scissors around the apparatus.

Using the rowing machine.start: A person straps both feet onto a rowing machine's footplates, leans forward with knees to the chest, grips the handle, and drives the legs back hard.
Using the rowing machine.middle: The person straightens the legs, swings the back open, pulls the handle to the lower ribs, then extends the arms and glides forward to the catch.
Using the rowing machine.end: Stroke follows stroke in even cadence with the seat shuttling along the rail, until the person eases off, takes a final light pull, and sits up.
Using the rowing machine.global: A person exercises using the rowing machine in a gym, pulling the handle through repeated cyclic strokes as the seat slides back and forth.

Using uneven bars.start: A gymnast chalks the hands, springs off a board to grasp the low bar, and kips upward to a straight-arm front support.
Using uneven bars.middle: The gymnast casts toward handstand on the low bar, releases to catch the high bar, then circles through giant swings with a brief release and regrasp.
Using uneven bars.end: The giant swings accelerate with the body stretched, and the gymnast releases into a high salto dismount, landing on the mat and straightening to salute.
Using uneven bars.global: A gymnast performs a routine using uneven bars, swinging and releasing between two bars of different heights before a high airborne dismount.

Vacuuming floor.start: A person wheels an upright vacuum into a carpeted room, plugs in the cord, switches it on, and pushes the whirring head forward across the carpet.
Vacuuming floor.middle: The person works overlapping back-and-forth strokes across the room, stretching the head under the sofa edge and pivoting around chair legs.
Vacuuming floor.end: The person tugs the cord free, finishes along the far wall and doorway strip, switches the vacuum off, and coils the cord before wheeling it out.
Vacuuming floor.global: A person is vacuuming floor at home, pushing an upright machine in repeated back-and-forth strokes that leave light tracks across the carpet.

Volleyball.start: Two teams face each other across a high indoor net as a server tosses and strikes the ball over, and a receiver bumps it up off both forearms.
Volleyball.middle: A setter lifts the ball high with the fingertips, a hitter leaps to spike it across the tape, blockers rise together, and a defender dives to dig the deflection.
Volleyball.end: The rally continues with players shuffling and calling until a final spike hammers into the open court, and the scoring team huddles for high fives.
Volleyball.global: Two teams play volleyball across a high net in an indoor gym, bumping, setting, and leaping to spike the ball back and forth.

Wakeboarding.start: A rider floats behind a boat with feet strapped sideways onto a wakeboard until the rope snaps taut, the board planes up, and the rider stands into a crouch.
Wakeboarding.middle: The rider carves outside the wake, cuts hard back to load the rope, launches off the wake's ramp, and grabs the board's edge mid-air.
Wakeboarding.end: The rider lands on the opposite wake's down-slope with bending knees, carves back to center in steady spray, then releases the handle and sinks into the water.
Wakeboarding.global: A rider goes wakeboarding behind a boat on open water, carving across the wake with a tow handle and launching airborne jumps.

Walking the dog.start: A person clips a leash onto a dog's collar at the front door and sets off along the sidewalk, the dog trotting ahead with nose low.
Walking the dog.middle: The dog pauses at a tree to sniff and pulls toward another walker while the person waits, gently checks the leash, and crosses at a corner together.
Walking the dog.end: The dog relieves itself on a grass strip, the person bends to clean up with a small bag, and the pair rounds the final corner toward home.
Walking the dog.global: A person is walking the dog through a quiet urban neighborhood, holding a leash while the animal trots, sniffs, and pauses along the sidewalk.

Washing dishes.start: A person at a sink stacked with dirty plates runs warm water, squeezes in dish soap to raise suds, and scrubs a plate with a soapy sponge.
Washing dishes.middle: The person circles the sponge over each plate, rinses it under clean water, slots it into the drying rack, then washes the glasses inside and out.
Washing dishes.end: The person scrubs the cutlery in handfuls, scours the last pot until its residue lifts, then drains the sink and wipes the counter beside the dripping rack.
Washing dishes.global: A person stands at a kitchen sink washing dishes, scrubbing plates, glasses, and pots with a soapy sponge before rinsing and racking them.

Washing face.start: A person leans over a bathroom sink, splashes warm water up over the face, and squeezes a dab of facial cleanser onto the fingertips.
Washing face.middle: The person spreads cleanser across cheeks, forehead, and chin, massaging the lather in small circles around the nose, jawline, and hairline with eyes squeezed shut.
Washing face.end: The person rinses repeatedly with cupped water until the foam clears, pats the skin dry with a soft towel, and smooths the face before the mirror.
Washing face.global: A person stands at a bathroom sink washing face, lathering cleanser in circular hand motions before rinsing the foam away and patting dry.

Washing hands.start: A person turns on the tap, catches a dollop of liquid soap in one palm, and rubs the palms together into a slippery white lather.
Washing hands.middle: The person scrubs the back of each hand, interlaces the fingers, circles the fingertips against each palm, and twists a fist around each thumb.
Washing hands.end: The person rinses the froth away under running water, shakes off the excess, turns off the tap, and dries each finger on a towel.
Washing hands.global: A person stands at a sink washing hands, rubbing soapy lather over palms, fingers, and thumbs before rinsing and drying them.

Waterskiing.start: A skier floats crouched behind a boat with ski tips up and straight arms on the tow handle until the boat surges and pulls the skier forward.
Waterskiing.middle: The skier rises out of the wake as the skis plane, stands tall with knees flexed, then leans onto one edge and slices outward through fanning spray.
Waterskiing.end: The skier cuts back across both wakes and carves long side-to-side arcs, finally releasing the handle and gliding to a slow sinking stop.
Waterskiing.global: A skier goes waterskiing behind a boat on open water, gripping a tow handle while carving arcs across the wake on two skis.

Waxing skis.start: A technician wipes clean the upturned base of a ski clamped in bench vises, then drips beads of molten wax along it from a heated iron.
Waxing skis.middle: The technician glides the iron slowly along the base, spreading wax into a glossy film that cools matte, then peels thin curls off with a plastic scraper.
Waxing skis.end: Shavings pile on the bench as the scraper clears the base, and the technician brushes briskly with nylon, buffs the base to a shine, and unclamps the ski.
Waxing skis.global: A technician works at a bench waxing skis, ironing molten wax onto a clamped base before scraping and brushing it to a shine.

Welding.start: A gloved welder clamps two metal pieces together on a workbench, lowers a dark face shield, and touches the torch to the seam, igniting a blinding arc.
Welding.middle: The welder guides the arc slowly along the joint as sparks shower onto the bench, a glowing bead lengthening in even ripples behind the torch.
Welding.end: The welder lifts the torch as the arc snaps out, raises the shield, chips slag from the cooling weld with a hammer, and brushes the finished bead clean.
Welding.global: A welder at an indoor workbench performs welding, guiding a handheld torch's bright arc along a clamped metal seam amid showering sparks.

Windsurfing.start: A windsurfer standing on a wide board hauls the dripping sail up from the water by the uphaul line and grasps the boom with both hands.
Windsurfing.middle: The sail fills with a snap as the windsurfer leans back against its pull, the board accelerating onto a plane and carving a gentle upwind arc.
Windsurfing.end: Spray flicks off the bow as the windsurfer skims along, steps around the mast to swing the sail across, and glides away on the new tack.
Windsurfing.global: A rider goes windsurfing on open water, balancing on a board while leaning against a wind-filled sail held by its boom.

Wrapping presents.start: A person sets a boxed gift beside a roll of patterned paper, measures out a length against the box, and cuts it with scissors in one straight line.
Wrapping presents.middle: The person pulls the paper up around the centered box, tapes the overlapped seam, folds the open ends into neat creased triangles, and tapes them down.
Wrapping presents.end: The person stretches ribbon around the package both ways, ties a bow on top and curls its ends with a scissor blade, then adds a small gift tag.
Wrapping presents.global: A person sits at a home table wrapping presents, folding and taping patterned paper around a box before finishing it with ribbon and a bow.

Zumba.start: An instructor faces rows of participants in a bright studio as Latin music begins, leading side-to-side steps and hip-rolling salsa moves the class picks up together.
Zumba.middle: The class marches through merengue steps, spins in place clapping on the beat, shimmies shoulders and hips in unison, and lunges side to side with punching arms.
Zumba.end: Sweat shines as the routine peaks in a fast full-body sequence, then the class eases into lighter steps with rolling stretches and cheers as the song ends.
Zumba.global: A group follows an instructor through a zumba class in a gym studio, dancing continuous rhythmic full-body moves to upbeat Latin music.
